name: Masala Egg Rice
description: Fragrant and flavorful spiced rice stir-fried with scrambled eggs, caramelized onions, tomatoes, and aromatic herbs.

instructions.instruction: Finely chop 1 onion, 2 tomatoes, 2 green chillies, and fresh coriander leaves.
Heat 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in a pan over medium flame. Crack in 2 eggs and scramble gently until just cooked. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, heat another tablespoon of oil, add cumin seeds, chopped onions, and sauté until golden brown.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes are soft and oil separates.
Toss in 2 cups of cooked rice and the scrambled eggs. Stir fry on high flame for 2 minutes to blend all flavors.
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander and squeeze a dash of fresh lemon juice. Serve hot!

name: Crispy Jeera Aloo (Cumin Spiced Potatoes)
description: Golden spiced potato cubes tossed with toasted cumin seeds, vibrant turmeric, and fiery green chillies.

instructions.instruction: Wash, peel, and dice 3 medium potatoes into 1-inch bite-sized cubes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a heavy-bottomed skillet over medium heat.
Add 1.5 teaspoons of cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add slit green chillies and diced potatoes. Sauté on medium-high heat for 3 minutes.
Lower heat, sprinkle turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cover with lid and cook for 8-10 minutes until fork-tender and crispy.
Uncover, roast on high heat for 1 minute for extra crispiness, and top with fresh chopped coriander.

name: Spicy Potato Onion Bhurji
description: A comforting homestyle dry curry featuring shredded potatoes and caramelized onions seasoned with green chillies and warm spices.

instructions.instruction: Thinly slice 2 onions and grate or finely dice 2 peeled potatoes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a kadai. Add cumin seeds and minced green chillies.
Add sliced onions and cook until translucent and lightly golden.
Add diced potatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Stir well to coat evenly.
Cover and simmer on medium-low for 8 minutes until potatoes are thoroughly cooked.
Garnish generously with finely chopped fresh coriander leaves.

name: Classic Tomato Onion Egg Curry
description: Rich and spicy North Indian style curry with pan-fried boiled eggs simmered in a luscious tomato and onion gravy.

instructions.instruction: Hard-boil 4 eggs, peel them, and prick lightly with a fork. Dust with turmeric and salt.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan and shallow-fry eggs until golden blistered. Set aside.
Sauté chopped onions, minced garlic, and ginger until deep golden brown.
Add diced tomatoes and spices. Cook until tomatoes are completely soft and fragrant.
Slide in eggs, simmer for 5 minutes, and finish with fresh coriander.

name: South Indian Tomato Rice (Thakkali Sadam)
description: Zesty and tangy temple-style spiced tomato rice tempered with mustard seeds, onions, and fresh chillies.

instructions.instruction: Cook 1 cup of raw rice until fluffy and let it cool completely.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan, crackle mustard seeds and green chillies.
Add sliced onions and cook until soft and translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt, and turmeric. Cook until soft and mushy.
Gently fold in cooked rice and top with coriander.

name: Quick Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Wok-tossed aromatic rice with finely diced vegetables, garlic, and savory soy sauce.

instructions.instruction: Finely dice carrots, bell peppers, onions, and mince garlic.
Flash-fry garlic and vegetables on high flame for 3 minutes.
Add cold cooked rice, soy sauce, and toss thoroughly for 2 minutes.

name: Creamy Garlic Tomato Pasta
description: Penne tossed in a silky homemade garlic-infused tomato sauce with herbs and olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Boil pasta in salted water for 9 minutes until al dente.
Sauté garlic and onion in olive oil until golden.
Add pureed tomatoes and simmer into a thick marinara sauce.
Stir in milk/cream and toss pasta until completely coated.

name: Paneer Bhurji (Scrambled Spiced Paneer)
description: Crumbled cottage cheese cooked with chopped onions, tomatoes, ginger, and aromatic Indian spices.

instructions.instruction: Crumble 200g of fresh paneer with your fingers.
Sauté chopped onions, ginger, and chillies in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and spices, cook until juicy.
Fold in crumbled paneer, cook for 3 minutes, garnish with coriander.

name: Homestyle Chicken Curry
description: Tender chicken pieces simmered in an aromatic onion, ginger, garlic, and tomato curry sauce.

instructions.instruction: Clean and cut 350g chicken into bite-sized curry cuts.
Sauté chopped onions, garlic, and ginger in oil until rich deep golden.
Add chopped tomatoes, chilli powder, turmeric, and salt. Cook until oil glazes on top.
Add chicken pieces and sear on high heat for 4 minutes to seal juices.
Add 1/2 cup warm water, cover and simmer on medium flame for 12 minutes until chicken is tender.
Finish with chopped coriander and serve hot with steamed rice or flatbreads.

name: Restaurant Style Butter Chicken
description: Succulent chicken in a velvety, buttery tomato and cream gravy infused with garlic and warm spices.

instructions.instruction: Pan-sear chicken cubes in 1 tbsp butter for 5 minutes until lightly browned. Set aside.
In the pan, sauté minced garlic, ginger, and onion in butter.
Add pureed ripe tomatoes and simmer until rich and concentrated.
Pour in milk or fresh cream and slide the chicken back into the gravy.
Garnish with a dollop of butter and fresh coriander.

name: Kadai Paneer & Bell Peppers
description: Paneer cubes stir-fried with crunchy bell peppers, onions, tomatoes, and freshly ground coriander spices.

instructions.instruction: Cut bell peppers and onions into 1-inch crunchy petals. Cube paneer.
Flash sauté bell peppers and onion petals on high flame for 2 minutes to keep them crisp. Remove.
In the same pan, make a rich onion-tomato masala with ginger, garlic, and spices.
Toss paneer and sauteed bell peppers into the masala. Cook for 2 minutes.

name: Creamy Palak Paneer (Spinach Cottage Cheese)
description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a vibrant, velvety spiced pureed spinach gravy with garlic and ginger.

instructions.instruction: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, then puree into a smooth green cream.
Sauté chopped onions, garlic, and ginger in oil until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and spices, cook until oil separates.
Pour in the vibrant green spinach puree, add paneer cubes, and simmer for 3 minutes.

name: Golden Homestyle Dal Tadka
description: Comforting yellow lentils tempered with sizzled cumin seeds, garlic, onions, tomatoes, and red chillies.

instructions.instruction: Boil yellow lentils in water with turmeric and salt until tender and creamy.
In a tadka pan, heat oil, add cumin seeds, sliced garlic, and chillies until aromatic.
Add chopped onions and tomatoes, sauté until soft.
Pour the sizzling tadka over the hot boiled dal. Top with coriander and serve.

name: Nourishing Dal Palak (Spinach Lentil Stew)
description: Wholesome protein-packed stew combining tender yellow lentils, wilted spinach leaves, garlic, and cumin.

instructions.instruction: Cook lentils until tender.
Sauté garlic, onions, and tomatoes in oil until fragrant.
Stir in chopped fresh spinach leaves until wilted.
Combine with the cooked dal, simmer for 3 minutes, and finish with lemon juice.

name: Spicy Mumbai Egg Bhurji
description: Street-style scrambled eggs tossed with chopped onions, tomatoes, butter, green chillies, and fresh herbs.

instructions.instruction: Finely chop onions, tomatoes, green chillies, and coriander.
Heat 1 tbsp butter/oil in a pan, sauté onions and green chillies for 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft and juicy.
Crack in 3 eggs, scramble gently on medium heat for 2-3 minutes until soft and creamy.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot with toast or pav.

name: Mediterranean Shakshuka
description: Gently poached eggs resting in a bubbling, spiced skillet sauce of crushed tomatoes, sweet onions, and bell peppers.

instructions.instruction: Sauté chopped onions, sliced bell peppers, and garlic in oil until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes, cumin, and salt; simmer into a thick chunky sauce.
Make 3 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover with lid and simmer on low heat for 5 minutes until egg whites are set and yolks remain runny.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Chilli & Garlic
description: Classic minimalist Italian pasta tossed with golden sautéed garlic slivers, red chillies, and extra virgin olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Boil pasta in salted water for 9 minutes until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta cooking water.
In a skillet, gently sizzle thinly sliced garlic and chopped chillies in oil until garlic is pale golden.
Toss in the hot pasta with a splash of starchy pasta water to emulsify the glossy sauce.
Garnish with freshly chopped herbs and serve immediately.

name: Fresh Tomato Cucumber Koshimbir Salad
description: Refreshing and crunchy chopped tomato and cucumber salad tossed with lemon juice, green chillies, and coriander.

instructions.instruction: Finely dice 2 tomatoes, 1 peeled cucumber, and 1 green chilli.
Transfer to a mixing bowl, toss with fresh coriander and salt.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top, toss well, and serve chilled.

name: Aromatic Vegetable Masala Pulao
description: Fragrant one-pot basmati rice infused with potatoes, carrots, onions, tomatoes, and toasted cumin.

instructions.instruction: Dice potatoes, onions, carrots, and tomatoes into bite-sized cubes.
Heat oil, add cumin seeds, and sauté onions until golden.
Add diced potatoes, carrots, and tomatoes with turmeric and salt; sauté for 3 minutes.
Add washed rice and 2 cups of water. Cover and cook on medium flame for 12 minutes until water is absorbed.

name: Crispy Garlic Herb Potato Wedges
description: Crunchy golden roasted potato wedges tossed in crushed garlic, cooking oil, and herbs.

instructions.instruction: Slice 3 washed potatoes into long wedges.
Toss wedges with crushed garlic, oil, and salt.
Pan-roast in a heavy skillet or air fry on medium-high for 18 minutes until golden and crispy.

name: Garlic Butter Chicken & Peppers Skillet
description: Tender seasoned chicken breast strips pan-seared with bell peppers, onions, and aromatic garlic butter.

instructions.instruction: Cut chicken into strips and slice bell peppers and onions.
Heat 1 tbsp butter and sear chicken for 6 minutes until cooked through. Set aside.
Sauté minced garlic, onions, and bell peppers in remaining butter for 3 minutes.
Toss chicken back in, season with pepper and salt, and serve hot.

name: Vegetable & Egg Breakfast Frittata
description: Fluffy baked skillet omelette loaded with diced bell peppers, sweet onions, tomatoes, and herbs.

instructions.instruction: Whisk 3 eggs with 2 tbsp milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Sauté diced onions, bell peppers, and tomatoes in a skillet for 4 minutes.
Pour the whisked egg mixture over the vegetables.
Cover with a lid and cook on low heat for 7 minutes until firm and fluffy.

name: Warm Spiced Apple & Oats & Honey Breakfast Bowl
description: A comforting wholesome breakfast bowl featuring warm rolled oats, sweet diced Apple & Honey, simmered gently to creamy perfection.

instructions.instruction: Dice Apple and Honey into bite-sized uniform pieces.
Bring milk or water to a gentle simmer in a saucepan over medium heat; stir in oats.
Fold in the diced ingredients with a pinch of cinnamon or honey; simmer for 4 minutes until thick and creamy.
Spoon into warm bowls, drizzle with honey or butter, and serve immediately.

name: Crispy Skillet Apple & Oats & Honey Crumble
description: Golden toasted pan-crumble with caramelized Apple, Oats, Honey lightly crisped with butter and spices.

instructions.instruction: Chop Apple and Oats and Honey evenly and place into a small bowl.
Melt 1 tbsp butter or oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat.
Add the ingredients and toast for 6-8 minutes, stirring frequently until fragrant and golden-crisp.
Cool for 2 minutes for extra crunch and enjoy warm as a snack or dessert.

description: Tender chicken bites pan-seared to golden perfection with Garlic, Lemon, fresh garlic, and cracked black pepper.

name: Crisp Pan-Sautéed Onion & Cabbage & Tomato Skillet
description: Fresh, vibrant medley of Onion, Cabbage, Tomato sautéed in hot cooking oil for exceptional caramelization and flavor.

instructions.title: Mise en Place & Knife Work
instructions.instruction: Wash and chop all ingredients: Cooking Oil, Onion, Cabbage, Tomato, Green Chilli, Garam Masala, Red Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder into uniform bite-sized pieces.
instructions.tip: Uniform sizes cook evenly at the exact same pace.

instructions.title: Pan Preheating & Oil Warming
instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wide pan or wok on medium-high heat until shimmering.
instructions.tip: A wide pan allows moisture to evaporate so vegetables roast rather than stew.

instructions.title: Aromatics & Tempering
instructions.instruction: Add garlic, green chillies, or cumin seeds. Let sizzle for 45 seconds until fragrant.
instructions.tip: Tempering aromatics in warm oil builds the flavor foundation.

instructions.title: High-Heat Sautéing
instructions.instruction: Add the chopped vegetables into the hot pan. Sauté on medium-high heat for 4 minutes so edges lightly blister.
instructions.tip: High heat caramelizes natural plant sugars for intense flavor.

instructions.title: Spice Blooming & Seasoning
instructions.instruction: Sprinkle in Garam Masala. Toss for 2 minutes to coat every piece.
instructions.tip: Toss continuously so spices toast without scorching.

instructions.title: Covered Brief Simmer
instructions.instruction: Cover with lid for 2 minutes on low heat to steam vegetables until tender-crisp.
instructions.tip: Brief steaming ensures core tenderness without losing crunch.

instructions.title: Uncovered Glaze & Crisp
instructions.instruction: Remove lid, turn heat to medium-high, and stir-fry for 1 minute until crisp.
instructions.tip: Evaporating moisture restores the crispy exterior.

instructions.title: Plating & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Garnish with chopped coriander or lemon juice and serve warm!
instructions.tip: Pairs wonderfully with rotis or as a wholesome side dish.

name: Aromatic Spiced Onion & Cabbage & Tomato One-Pan Medley
description: A warm, flavorful homestyle dish bringing together Onion and Cabbage and Tomato simmered gently in cooking oil.

instructions.title: Vegetable Prep & Peeling
instructions.instruction: Wash, peel, and cut Cooking Oil, Onion, Cabbage, Tomato, Green Chilli, Garam Masala, Red Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder into uniform pieces. Assemble your spices and cooking oil.
instructions.tip: Peeling removes tough fibrous outer skin for quick cooking.

instructions.title: Kadai Preheating & Oil Tempering
instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a kadai over medium flame. Add mustard seeds and cumin; let crackle for 30 seconds.
instructions.tip: Crackling seeds release nutty roasted fragrance.

instructions.title: Sautéing Onions & Ginger-Garlic
instructions.instruction: Add chopped onions and green chillies into hot oil. Sauté for 3 minutes until soft and translucent.
instructions.tip: Softened onions give body and rich sweetness to the gravy.

instructions.title: Masala Blooming & Paste
instructions.instruction: Lower heat. Add Garam Masala. Sauté in oil for 45 seconds with 2 tbsp water to form a paste.
instructions.tip: A splash of water keeps dry ground spices from burning.

instructions.title: Adding Vegetables & Masala Coat
instructions.instruction: Add the chopped vegetables into the spiced kadai. Sauté on medium-high flame for 3 minutes to coat thoroughly.
instructions.tip: Sautéing before simmering seals in deep masala flavor.

instructions.title: Covered Simmering
instructions.instruction: Pour in 1/2 cup water, cover tightly with a lid, and simmer on medium-low flame for 7-8 minutes until fork-tender.
instructions.tip: Simmering under a closed lid cooks vegetables gently in trapped steam.

instructions.title: Uncovered Gravy Reduction
instructions.instruction: Remove lid, turn flame to medium, and simmer uncovered for 2-3 minutes until gravy thickens into a rich coating.
instructions.tip: Adjust cooking time based on whether you prefer dry roast or gravy.

instructions.title: Final Seasoning, Resting & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Taste and adjust salt. Garnish with chopped fresh coriander leaves, rest 2 minutes, and serve hot!
instructions.tip: Resting allows flavors to meld into a harmonious homestyle dish.

name: Homestyle Spiced Cabbage Curry (Patta Gobhi Poriyal)
description: Tender shredded cabbage pan-roasted in golden cooking oil with mustard seeds, green chillies, turmeric, and homestyle spices.

instructions.title: Shredding & Mise en Place
instructions.instruction: Wash and finely shred cabbage into thin ribbons. Finely slice green chillies, onions, and curry leaves.
instructions.tip: Finely shredded cabbage cooks quickly without releasing excess water.

instructions.title: Kadai Preheating & Oil Tempering
instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wide kadai over medium flame. Add mustard seeds, cumin, and chana dal; let crackle for 45 seconds.
instructions.tip: Fried chana dal adds a delightful nutty crunch.

instructions.title: Sautéing Aromatics
instructions.instruction: Add chopped onions, green chillies, and curry leaves into the hot oil. Sauté for 3 minutes until translucent.
instructions.tip: Sautéing aromatics builds the savory flavor base.

instructions.title: Spice Blooming
instructions.instruction: Lower flame. Sprinkle in turmeric powder, pinch of asafoetida (hing), and salt. Stir for 20 seconds.
instructions.tip: Turmeric imparts brilliant golden color and removes raw aroma.

instructions.title: Adding Shredded Cabbage
instructions.instruction: Add shredded cabbage into the kadai. Toss vigorously on medium-high heat for 3 minutes so cabbage is glistening with spiced oil.
instructions.tip: High heat sears the cabbage ribbons while preserving sweet crunch.

instructions.title: Covered Steam Cooking
instructions.instruction: Cover with lid and cook on low heat for 4 minutes in its own trapped steam without adding water.
instructions.tip: Cabbage has natural moisture; do not add water or it becomes soggy.

instructions.title: Uncovered Crisp & Roast
instructions.instruction: Remove lid. Increase flame to medium and sauté uncovered for 2-3 minutes until moisture evaporates and edges get lightly golden.
instructions.tip: Uncovered roasting gives a smoky pan-fried flavor.

instructions.title: Finishing & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Garnish with freshly grated coconut or chopped coriander leaves. Serve hot with rotis or dal rice!
instructions.tip: Grated coconut adds authentic coastal sweetness.

name: Authentic South Indian Drumstick & Vegetable Sambar
description: Traditional piping hot lentil stew simmered with Toor Dal, Drumstick, Tomato, tamarind, and freshly roasted sambar spices in golden cooking oil.

instructions.title: Lentil & Veggie Mise en Place
instructions.instruction: Rinse toor dal until water runs clear; chop drumsticks, tomatoes, and vegetables into uniform batons. Measure sambar powder, tamarind, and cooking oil.
instructions.tip: Evenly cut drumsticks and vegetables cook uniformly in the dal broth.

instructions.title: Cooking & Mashing Dal
instructions.instruction: Cook toor dal with turmeric and 2 cups water until soft and creamy; mash well with a whisk to create a silky body.
instructions.tip: Mashing the dal creates a rich, homogeneous consistency.

instructions.title: Tempering in Hot Oil
instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a deep pot. Add mustard seeds, cumin, fenugreek seeds, dry red chillies, and curry leaves; let splutter for 45 seconds.
instructions.tip: Tempering whole spices in hot oil infuses essential coastal aromas.

instructions.title: Sautéing Shallots & Aromatics
instructions.instruction: Add sliced shallots or onions. Sauté on medium flame for 3 minutes until translucent and sweet.
instructions.tip: Shallots provide authentic Udupi sambar sweetness.

instructions.title: Vegetable Simmer with Tamarind
instructions.instruction: Add drumsticks and vegetables. Pour in tamarind extract and 1 cup water. Simmer covered for 6 minutes until vegetables are tender.
instructions.tip: Cooking vegetables directly in tamarind water keeps them intact without getting mushy.

instructions.title: Masala Blooming & Dal Incorporation
instructions.instruction: Stir in 2 tbsp sambar powder, salt, and pour in the mashed dal. Mix thoroughly to blend the broth.
instructions.tip: Whisk gently while adding dal to ensure no lumps form.

instructions.title: Rolling Boil & Aroma Infusion
instructions.instruction: Bring sambar to a rolling boil on medium-low heat for 4 minutes until aromatic foam rises to the surface.
instructions.tip: A slow rolling boil lets the sambar powder fuse with the lentil broth.

instructions.title: Garnish, Resting & Service
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Garnish generously with freshly chopped coriander leaves. Let rest for 2 minutes before serving hot with steamed rice, idli, or dosa!
instructions.tip: Resting allows the flavors to settle into a rich, harmonious stew.

name: Crispy Golden Jeera Aloo Roast
description: Golden potato cubes shallow-roasted in sizzling cooking oil with cumin seeds, turmeric, and cracked black pepper.

instructions.title: Dicing & Rinsing Potatoes
instructions.instruction: Peel potatoes and cut into uniform 3/4-inch cubes. Rinse in cold water to remove excess surface starch, then pat dry.
instructions.tip: Rinsing excess starch prevents potatoes from sticking together and ensures a crisp crust.

instructions.title: Pan Heating & Cumin Tempering
instructions.instruction: Heat 2-3 tbsp cooking oil in a wide heavy skillet over medium heat. Add 1 tsp cumin seeds; let sizzle until aromatic.
instructions.tip: Generous cumin seeds give signature fragrant nutty flavor.

instructions.title: Pan-Roasting Potatoes
instructions.instruction: Add potato cubes in a single layer. Roast undisturbed on medium flame for 5 minutes until underside is golden.
instructions.tip: Resist stirring during the first 4 minutes so a golden crust forms.

instructions.title: Flipping & Second Side Roast
instructions.instruction: Flip potato cubes with a spatula. Cook for 4 minutes until all sides are blistered and golden.
instructions.tip: Keep heat medium so the interior cooks through while exterior crisps.

instructions.title: Spicing & Masala Coat
instructions.instruction: Lower heat. Sprinkle turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and amchur (dry mango powder). Toss for 2 minutes.
instructions.tip: Amchur adds delicious restaurant-style tangy punch.

instructions.title: Final Crisp & Seasoning Check
instructions.instruction: Test a cube with a fork for fork-tenderness. Stir-fry on medium-high for 1 minute until ultra-crispy.
instructions.tip: High heat finish maximizes crunch.

instructions.title: Garnish & Plating
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Garnish generously with freshly chopped coriander leaves and serve hot with puris or rotis!
instructions.tip: Best enjoyed piping hot straight from the skillet.

name: Pan-Seared Golden Onion & Chicken Skillet
description: Tender chicken pieces pan-seared to juicy perfection in sizzling cooking oil with Onion.

instructions.title: Chicken Cutting & Pat Dry
instructions.instruction: Wash chicken and pat completely dry with paper towels. Cut into uniform 1.5-inch pieces.
instructions.tip: A dry surface ensures intense browning rather than boiling in moisture.

instructions.title: Seasoning & Marination
instructions.instruction: Toss chicken with salt, cracked black pepper, and your seasonings. Let sit for 3 minutes.
instructions.tip: Pre-salting dissolves surface protein to trap juicy moisture.

instructions.title: Skillet Preheating
instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
instructions.tip: The skillet must be very hot so chicken sears immediately upon contact.

instructions.title: Pan-Sear First Side
instructions.instruction: Lay chicken pieces in the pan in a single layer. Sear undisturbed for 4 minutes until deeply golden.
instructions.tip: Do not move the pieces during the first 3 minutes to build a crust.

instructions.title: Flipping & Second Side Sear
instructions.instruction: Flip each piece with tongs. Sear the second side on medium flame for 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.tip: Chicken is done when internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F).

instructions.title: Basting with Pan Juices
instructions.instruction: Add aromatics and spoon the hot pan drippings over the chicken for 1 minute for a glossy glaze.
instructions.tip: Pan-basting distributes seasoning across the exterior crust.

instructions.title: Resting & Slicing
instructions.instruction: Transfer chicken onto a warm plate and rest for 2 minutes to let juices settle evenly.
instructions.tip: Resting prevents juices from running out when cut.

instructions.title: Plating & Service
instructions.instruction: Garnish with fresh herbs and a wedge of lemon. Serve sizzling hot!
instructions.tip: Serve immediately for the best crispy skin and juicy center.

name: Sizzling High-Heat Onion & Chicken Stir-Fry
description: Flash-seared chicken cubes cooked on high heat in cooking oil with savory aromatics for intense flavor.

instructions.title: Thin Slicing & Veggie Prep
instructions.instruction: Slice chicken into thin bite-sized strips. Thinly slice garlic, ginger, and vegetables.
instructions.tip: Thin uniform strips cook rapidly on high wok heat.

instructions.title: Wok Preheating on High Flame
instructions.instruction: Place wok on high heat until wisps of smoke appear. Swirl 2 tbsp cooking oil around the walls.
instructions.tip: High heat imparts restaurant-grade wok-hei.

instructions.title: Flash-Searing Chicken
instructions.instruction: Add chicken strips to the blazing wok. Stir-fry vigorously for 4 minutes until golden and seared.
instructions.tip: Keep moving chicken continuously to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: Aromatics Sauté
instructions.instruction: Toss in minced garlic and ginger. Sauté on high flame for 1 minute until fragrant.
instructions.tip: Add garlic after chicken so it does not burn on high heat.

instructions.title: Vegetable & Sauce Addition
instructions.instruction: Add chopped vegetables, soy sauce or seasonings. Stir-fry rapidly for 2 minutes to keep crunch.
instructions.tip: Brief cooking maintains vibrant vegetable colors and crispness.

instructions.title: High-Heat Glaze
instructions.instruction: Toss continuously on maximum flame for 1 minute so sauce reduces to a glossy coating.
instructions.tip: The glaze should cling tightly without pooling at the bottom.

instructions.title: Plating & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Transfer steaming hot onto a serving platter, garnish with scallions, and serve immediately!
instructions.tip: Stir fries are best enjoyed straight from the wok.

name: Chef's Garam Masala Spiced Onion & Chicken Roast
description: Chicken roasted on a pan in aromatic cooking oil with Garam Masala & Red Chilli Powder & Turmeric Powder & Chicken Masala.

instructions.title: Chicken Mise en Place & Prep
instructions.instruction: Rinse chicken, pat dry with paper towels, and cut into uniform 1.5-inch pieces. Measure out 2 tbsp cooking oil, Garam Masala, Red Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder, Chicken Masala, salt, and slice aromatics.
instructions.tip: Drying chicken surface ensures spices stick and roast evenly.

instructions.title: Kadai Preheating & Oil Tempering
instructions.instruction: Place a heavy kadai on medium heat. Pour in 2 tbsp cooking oil and swirl until shimmering gently.
instructions.tip: A heavy-bottomed kadai distributes heat evenly and prevents hot spots.

instructions.title: Aromatics Sauté
instructions.instruction: Add chopped onions, minced ginger-garlic, and green chillies into the hot oil. Sauté on medium heat for 3 minutes until golden-brown.
instructions.tip: Sautéing onions till golden gives the roast its rich sweet foundation.

instructions.title: Masala Blooming & Paste
instructions.instruction: Lower flame to low. Add Garam Masala. Bloom in warm oil for 45 seconds, adding 2 tbsp water to create a rich bubbling paste.
instructions.tip: Adding a splash of water prevents dry masala powders from scorching.

instructions.title: High-Heat Chicken Sear
instructions.instruction: Increase flame to medium-high. Add chicken pieces into the bubbling masala. Sauté vigorously for 5 minutes, coating every piece thoroughly while searing the outer crust.
instructions.tip: Sear chicken on high heat to lock inside juices and infuse deep flavor.

instructions.title: Covered Simmer & Tenderizing
instructions.instruction: Reduce flame to low-medium. Cover tightly with a lid and simmer for 8 minutes in natural juices, stirring once halfway.
instructions.tip: Trapped steam tenderizes the chicken to the bone while keeping it succulent.

instructions.title: Uncovered Reduction & Roast
instructions.instruction: Remove lid. Sauté uncovered on medium heat for 3-4 minutes until gravy reduces into a thick, glossy, deep-roasted masala coating.
instructions.tip: Stir continuously so the masala roasts evenly around every chicken piece.

instructions.title: Final Seasoning, Resting & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Adjust salt, garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves and a squeeze of fresh lemon. Rest 2 minutes before serving hot!
instructions.tip: Resting allows internal juices to redistribute for ultimate tenderness.

name: Chef's Garam Masala Spiced Chicken & Onion Roast
description: Chicken roasted on a pan in aromatic cooking oil with Garam Masala.

instructions.title: Chicken Mise en Place & Prep
instructions.instruction: Rinse chicken, pat dry with paper towels, and cut into uniform 1.5-inch pieces. Measure out 2 tbsp cooking oil, Garam Masala, salt, and slice aromatics.
instructions.tip: Drying chicken surface ensures spices stick and roast evenly.

instructions.title: Kadai Preheating & Oil Tempering
instructions.instruction: Place a heavy kadai on medium heat. Pour in 2 tbsp cooking oil and swirl until shimmering gently.
instructions.tip: A heavy-bottomed kadai distributes heat evenly and prevents hot spots.

instructions.title: Aromatics Sauté
instructions.instruction: Add chopped onions, minced ginger-garlic, and green chillies into the hot oil. Sauté on medium heat for 3 minutes until golden-brown.
instructions.tip: Sautéing onions till golden gives the roast its rich sweet foundation.

instructions.title: Masala Blooming & Paste
instructions.instruction: Lower flame to low. Add Garam Masala. Bloom in warm oil for 45 seconds, adding 2 tbsp water to create a rich bubbling paste.
instructions.tip: Adding a splash of water prevents dry masala powders from scorching.

instructions.title: High-Heat Chicken Sear
instructions.instruction: Increase flame to medium-high. Add chicken pieces into the bubbling masala. Sauté vigorously for 5 minutes, coating every piece thoroughly while searing the outer crust.
instructions.tip: Sear chicken on high heat to lock inside juices and infuse deep flavor.

instructions.title: Covered Simmer & Tenderizing
instructions.instruction: Reduce flame to low-medium. Cover tightly with a lid and simmer for 8 minutes in natural juices, stirring once halfway.
instructions.tip: Trapped steam tenderizes the chicken to the bone while keeping it succulent.

instructions.title: Uncovered Reduction & Roast
instructions.instruction: Remove lid. Sauté uncovered on medium heat for 3-4 minutes until gravy reduces into a thick, glossy, deep-roasted masala coating.
instructions.tip: Stir continuously so the masala roasts evenly around every chicken piece.

instructions.title: Final Seasoning, Resting & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Adjust salt, garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves and a squeeze of fresh lemon. Rest 2 minutes before serving hot!
instructions.tip: Resting allows internal juices to redistribute for ultimate tenderness.

name: Crisp Pan-Sautéed Cauliflower & Onion & Tomato Skillet
description: Fresh medley of Cauliflower, Onion, Tomato sautéed in hot cooking oil with garlic and homestyle spices.

instructions.title: Mise en Place & Knife Work
instructions.instruction: Wash and chop Cooking Oil, Cauliflower, Onion, Tomato, Coriander, Curry Leaves, Salt, Red Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder, Garam Masala into uniform bite-sized pieces.
instructions.tip: Uniform sizes cook evenly at the exact same pace.

instructions.title: Pan Preheating & Oil Warming
instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wide pan on medium-high heat until shimmering.
instructions.tip: A wide pan allows moisture to evaporate so vegetables roast rather than stew.

instructions.title: Aromatics & Tempering
instructions.instruction: Add garlic, green chillies, or cumin seeds. Let sizzle for 45 seconds until fragrant.
instructions.tip: Tempering aromatics in warm oil builds the flavor foundation.

instructions.title: High-Heat Sautéing
instructions.instruction: Add the chopped vegetables into the hot pan. Sauté on medium-high heat for 4 minutes so edges lightly blister.
instructions.tip: High heat caramelizes natural plant sugars for intense flavor.

instructions.title: Spice Blooming & Seasoning
instructions.instruction: Sprinkle in Red Chilli Powder. Toss for 2 minutes to coat every piece.
instructions.tip: Toss continuously so spices toast without scorching.

instructions.title: Covered Brief Simmer
instructions.instruction: Cover with lid for 2 minutes on low heat to steam vegetables until tender-crisp.
instructions.tip: Brief steaming ensures core tenderness without losing crunch.

instructions.title: Uncovered Glaze & Crisp
instructions.instruction: Remove lid, turn heat to medium-high, and stir-fry for 1 minute until crisp.
instructions.tip: Evaporating moisture restores the crispy exterior.

instructions.title: Plating & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Garnish with chopped coriander or lemon juice and serve warm!
instructions.tip: Pairs wonderfully with rotis or as a wholesome side dish.

name: Pan-Seared Golden Onion & Mushroom & Spinach Skillet
description: Tender chicken pieces pan-seared to juicy perfection in sizzling olive oil with Onion, Mushroom, Spinach, Milk, Pasta, Cheese.

instructions.title: Chicken Cutting & Pat Dry
instructions.instruction: Wash chicken and pat completely dry with paper towels. Cut into uniform 1.5-inch pieces.
instructions.tip: A dry surface ensures intense browning rather than boiling in moisture.

instructions.title: Seasoning & Marination
instructions.instruction: Toss chicken with salt, cracked black pepper, and your seasonings. Let sit for 3 minutes.
instructions.tip: Pre-salting dissolves surface protein to trap juicy moisture.

instructions.title: Skillet Preheating
instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
instructions.tip: The skillet must be very hot so chicken sears immediately upon contact.

instructions.title: Pan-Sear First Side
instructions.instruction: Lay chicken pieces in the pan in a single layer. Sear undisturbed for 4 minutes until deeply golden.
instructions.tip: Do not move the pieces during the first 3 minutes to build a crust.

instructions.title: Flipping & Second Side Sear
instructions.instruction: Flip each piece with tongs. Sear the second side on medium flame for 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.tip: Chicken is done when internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F).

instructions.title: Basting with Pan Juices
instructions.instruction: Add aromatics and spoon the hot pan drippings over the chicken for 1 minute for a glossy glaze.
instructions.tip: Pan-basting distributes seasoning across the exterior crust.

instructions.title: Resting & Slicing
instructions.instruction: Transfer chicken onto a warm plate and rest for 2 minutes to let juices settle evenly.
instructions.tip: Resting prevents juices from running out when cut.

instructions.title: Plating & Service
instructions.instruction: Garnish with fresh herbs and a wedge of lemon. Serve sizzling hot!
instructions.tip: Serve immediately for the best crispy skin and juicy center.

name: Royal Hyderabadi Dum Chicken Biryani
description: Aromatic layered basmati rice and marinated chicken cooked on dum with saffron, fried onions (birista), fresh mint, and fragrant whole spices.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala, and lemon juice for at least 30 minutes.
Parboil basmati rice with whole spices (cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf) until 70% cooked.
In a heavy-bottom pot, arrange marinated chicken at the bottom, then layer parboiled rice over it. Garnish with fried onions, mint, and saffron milk.
Seal the pot with dough or foil and cook on slow dum for 35 minutes until chicken is succulent and rice is fluffy.

name: Lucknowi Chicken Awadhi Biryani
description: Subtle and royal Awadhi style biryani prepared with aromatic chicken yakhni broth, long grain basmati rice, kewra water, and gentle whole spices.

instructions.instruction: Simmer chicken with whole spices, ginger, and garlic to extract a rich fragrant yakhni broth.
Cook basmati rice in the infused yakhni stock until three-quarters done.
Layer cooked chicken pieces, fragrant rice, kewra water, and pure ghee in a sealed handi.
Dum cook on low flame for 20 minutes for delicate royal aroma.

name: Malabar Chicken Biryani
description: Famous Kerala coastal biryani made with fragrant small-grain Jeerakasala rice, cashew nuts, golden raisins, and rich southern spices.

instructions.instruction: Cook marinated chicken in a spicy onion-tomato gravy with green chilli paste and fennel.
Cook ghee rice seasoned with cloves and cardamom.
Layer chicken masala with fragrant ghee rice, fried cashews, raisins, and chopped coriander.
Dum cook tightly covered on low heat for 15 minutes.

name: Kolkata Style Chicken & Potato Biryani
description: Iconic Kolkata biryani with tender chicken, whole spiced melt-in-mouth potatoes, and boiled eggs infused with rose water and meetha attar.

instructions.instruction: Fry large potato halves with a pinch of turmeric until golden, then slow-braise until tender.
Cook chicken with yogurt, garlic, ginger, and biryani spices until rich and aromatic.
Layer aromatic basmati rice with chicken, braised potatoes, boiled eggs, and scented milk.
Seal and dum cook on low flame for 25 minutes.

name: Chettinad Spicy Chicken Masala
description: Fiery and robust Tamil Nadu curry loaded with freshly roasted coriander seeds, black peppercorns, curry leaves, and tender chicken pieces.

instructions.instruction: Dry roast black peppercorns, coriander seeds, cumin, and dry red chillies, then grind into a fresh spice mix.
Sauté chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and curry leaves in oil until deep brown.
Add chicken, tomatoes, and ground Chettinad masala. Sauté until oil separates.
Simmer with water for 15 minutes until chicken is tender and sauce coats the meat.

name: Kashmiri Mutton Rogan Josh
description: Legendary slow-cooked Kashmiri lamb curry with vibrant Kashmiri red chillies, fennel powder, ginger, and aromatic whole spices in a velvety yogurt gravy.

instructions.instruction: Brown meat pieces in mustard oil with black cardamom, cloves, and bay leaf.
Whisk yogurt with Kashmiri chilli powder and fennel powder; pour into the pan on low heat.
Add ginger powder and warm water, cover and slow-simmer until meat is fork-tender.
Finish with a sprinkle of garam masala and fresh coriander.

name: Dhaba Style Spicy Chicken Curry
description: Rustic Punjabi highway dhaba chicken curry with coarse onion-tomato masala, whole coriander seeds, and a spicy, mouthwatering gravy.

instructions.instruction: Heat oil, add cumin and crushed whole coriander seeds till aromatic.
Add chopped onions, sauté until deep reddish brown, then stir in ginger-garlic paste.
Toss in chicken, chopped tomatoes, turmeric, and chilli powder; sauté on high heat for 6 minutes.
Add warm water, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until chicken is tender.

name: Coastal Prawn Masala Fry
description: Juicy prawns tossed in a spicy, tangy coastal masala of caramelized onions, garlic, tomatoes, and freshly squeezed lemon juice.

instructions.instruction: Marinate cleaned prawns with turmeric, red chilli powder, and lemon juice for 10 minutes.
Sauté chopped onions, green chillies, and garlic in oil until translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes and spices, cooking until soft and pulpy.
Add prawns, toss on high heat for 4-5 minutes until curled and pink. Garnish with coriander.

name: Goan Fish Curry with Coconut
description: Traditional Goan seaside fish curry with coconut milk, tangy tamarind, garlic, and turmeric, best savored with steamed rice.

instructions.instruction: Blend grated coconut, garlic, cumin, coriander seeds, and Kashmiri chillies into a smooth paste.
Heat oil, sauté onions and green chillies, then add the ground coconut spice paste.
Pour in tamarind water and coconut milk, bringing the curry to a gentle simmer.
Slide in fish fillets and simmer gently for 6 minutes until cooked through without breaking.

name: Crispy Amritsari Fish Fry
description: Crispy Punjabi street-style fish fritters marinated in carom seeds (ajwain), gram flour, ginger, and lemon juice, deep fried to golden crunch.

instructions.instruction: Marinate boneless fish fillets with ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, turmeric, and carom seeds.
Coat fish with spiced besan (gram flour) and rice flour batter for extra crispiness.
Deep fry or air fry in hot oil until golden brown and crackling.
Sprinkle chat masala and serve with sliced onions and mint chutney.

name: Creamy Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Charred smoky tandoori chicken tikka cubes simmered in a rich, creamy, spiced tomato and butter gravy garnished with fresh coriander.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken pieces with yogurt and tikka spices, then pan-sear until charred.
In a pan, cook onions, ginger, garlic, and tomato puree until oil separates.
Add cream, butter, and kasuri methi, stirring into a luscious sauce.
Add the grilled chicken tikka cubes and simmer for 8 minutes to absorb flavors.

name: Shahi Mughlai Chicken Korma
description: Mildly spiced, luxurious chicken curry simmered in a velvety gravy of ground cashews, yogurt, fried onions, and saffron.

instructions.instruction: Puree golden fried onions with soaked cashews and yogurt into a smooth paste.
Heat ghee, sauté chicken with whole spices and ginger-garlic until white and sealed.
Stir in the korma paste, coriander powder, and cardamom. Cook on low heat.
Add a splash of saffron milk, cover, and gently simmer for 15 minutes.

name: Spiced Keema Matar (Minced Meat & Green Peas)
description: Savory minced meat and sweet green peas cooked with caramelized onions, tomatoes, green chillies, and fragrant garam masala.

instructions.instruction: Heat oil, add whole spices and finely chopped onions; cook until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes, cooking until soft and aromatic.
Add minced meat, breaking it up and browning over medium-high heat.
Add green peas and a little warm water; simmer covered for 10 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

name: Kerala Egg Roast (Mutta Roast)
description: Spicy and tangy Kerala-style hard boiled egg roast in a thick caramelized onion, ginger, tomato, and curry leaf gravy. Perfect with Appam or Parotta.

instructions.instruction: Hard-boil 4 eggs, peel and make shallow slits.
In coconut oil, sauté sliced onions and curry leaves until deep golden brown.
Add ginger, garlic, tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder, and coriander powder; cook to a thick paste.
Toss in the boiled eggs, coating well with the thick spicy masala for 4 minutes.

name: Mangalorean Chicken Sukka (Kori Sukka)
description: Dry-roasted Mangalorean chicken specialty cooked with freshly grated coconut, aromatic roasted spices, curry leaves, and tamarind.

instructions.instruction: Cook chicken with turmeric, sliced onions, and ginger-garlic paste until half done.
Dry roast red chillies, coriander seeds, cumin, fenugreek, and peppercorns, then grind with tamarind.
Coarsely pulse grated coconut with garlic and cumin seeds.
Simmer chicken with ground masala till dry, then toss in the spiced coconut mixture until aromatic and toasted.

name: Dal Makhani (Slow-Cooked Black Lentils)
description: Velvety slow-simmered whole black urad dal and kidney beans enriched with butter, cream, smoked Kashmiri chillies, and kasuri methi.

instructions.instruction: Pressure cook soaked black lentils and rajma with salt and whole spices until creamy soft.
Sauté ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree, and Kashmiri chilli powder in butter until oil releases.
Combine cooked lentils with the tomato masala, mashing lightly with a ladle.
Simmer on low flame for 25 minutes with butter and cream. Finish with kasuri methi.

name: Punjabi Chana Masala (Spiced Chickpea Curry)
description: Hearty chickpeas stewed in an onion-tomato gravy infused with tea-leaf infused stock, anardana (pomegranate seeds), and aromatic spices.

instructions.instruction: Boil soaked chickpeas with a tea bag, bay leaf, and cinnamon until meltingly tender.
Sauté onions until deep reddish brown, then add ginger, garlic, and green chillies.
Add tomato puree, chana masala powder, and dry mango powder (amchur); cook until oil leaves sides.
Add chickpeas with broth, mash a few to thicken, and simmer for 10 minutes.

name: Royal Shahi Paneer
description: Soft cottage cheese cubes bathed in a velvety royal gravy prepared with cashew nuts, almonds, saffron, and sweet aromatic cardamom.

instructions.instruction: Boil onions, cashews, and garlic in water for 10 minutes, then blend into a silky white paste.
Melt butter in a pan with green cardamoms and cinnamon; pour in the blended cashew puree.
Stir in tomato puree, turmeric, Kashmiri red chilli, and a pinch of sugar; cook on low heat.
Slide in fresh paneer cubes, sprinkle saffron and kasuri methi, and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: Melt-in-Mouth Malai Kofta
description: Crispy golden paneer and potato dumplings stuffed with nuts, served in a rich, buttery, spiced cream and tomato gravy.

instructions.instruction: Mash boiled potatoes and paneer with cornstarch and salt; shape into balls stuffed with chopped nuts.
Deep fry or air fry kofta balls until crispy and golden brown.
Cook onion, cashew, and tomato gravy with gentle spices until smooth and silky.
Pour hot luscious gravy over the crisp koftas right before serving to keep them tender.

name: Smoky Baingan Bharta (Charred Eggplant Mash)
description: Rustic Punjabi mashed eggplant roasted over an open flame for a deep smoky flavor, sautéed with onions, green chillies, garlic, and tomatoes.

instructions.instruction: Slit large eggplant, insert garlic cloves, and roast over direct stove flame until charred and tender.
Peel the charred skin off and coarsely mash the smoky flesh.
Heat mustard oil, sauté onions, green chillies, and ginger until caramelized.
Add tomatoes, spices, and the mashed eggplant. Sauté vigorously for 8 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

name: Tandoori Spiced Paneer Tikka
description: Marinated cottage cheese, crunchy bell peppers, and red onions skewered and roasted until edges are charred and fragrant.

instructions.instruction: Whisk thick yogurt with mustard oil, ajwain, red chilli powder, ginger-garlic paste, and chaat masala.
Toss cubed paneer, bell peppers, and onion petals in marinade for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and sear in a hot grill pan or bake at 220°C until charred on edges.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice, dust chaat masala, and serve with mint dip.

name: Methi Matar Malai
description: Rich North Indian curry combining slightly bitter fresh fenugreek leaves and sweet green peas in a smooth, creamy milk-cream gravy.

instructions.instruction: Chop fresh methi leaves, sprinkle with salt, rest 10 mins and squeeze out excess bitter juice.
Boil green peas until sweet and tender.
Sauté onion-cashew paste with mild spices and green chillies in butter.
Add methi, peas, cream, and milk. Simmer gently for 6 minutes.

name: Authentic Kashmiri Dum Aloo
description: Baby potatoes deep fried till golden, then simmered in a fragrant yogurt-based gravy flavored with Kashmiri red chillies, ginger powder, and fennel.

instructions.instruction: Boil and prick baby potatoes with a fork, then fry in mustard oil till golden and crisp.
Whisk yogurt with fennel powder, dry ginger powder, and Kashmiri chilli powder.
Temper oil with cloves, cardamom, and hing, then pour in spiced yogurt mixture.
Add fried potatoes, seal lid, and dum cook on very low flame for 15 minutes.

name: Crispy Spiced Bhindi Masala (Okra Fry)
description: Tender ladyfinger / okra pieces stir-fried with sliced onions, amchur (dry mango powder), coriander, and cumin until crisp and non-slimy.

instructions.instruction: Wash, thoroughly dry okra with a cloth, and slice into bite-sized rounds to prevent stickiness.
Heat oil, add cumin seeds, sliced onions, and green chillies; sauté until golden.
Add chopped bhindi, turmeric, and coriander powder. Sauté on medium-high without lid.
Sprinkle dry mango powder (amchur) and salt at the very end to keep okra crisp.

name: Aloo Gobi Matar Masala
description: Classic comforting North Indian dry curry of tender potatoes, cauliflower florets, and sweet green peas braised with ginger and tomatoes.

instructions.instruction: Sauté cumin seeds, ginger juliennes, and green chillies in oil till sizzling.
Add diced potatoes and cauliflower florets; sauté for 5 minutes on medium flame.
Stir in chopped tomatoes, green peas, turmeric, and red chilli powder. Cover with a splash of water.
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander and garam masala.

name: Punjabi Rajma Masala (Red Kidney Bean Curry)
description: Comforting, slow-cooked Punjabi red kidney beans in an aromatic onion, ginger-garlic, and tomato gravy served piping hot over steamed basmati rice.

instructions.instruction: Pressure cook soaked rajma with salt and water until soft and easily mashable.
Sauté chopped onions in ghee/oil until deep golden brown, then add ginger-garlic paste.
Add pureed tomatoes and spices, cooking until oil glistens on the surface.
Add the boiled kidney beans with their liquid, lightly mash a few spoonfuls, and simmer for 15 minutes.

name: Gujarati Sev Tameta Nu Shaak
description: Sweet, sour, and spicy traditional Gujarati tomato curry topped with crunchy crispy gram flour sev and fresh coriander leaves. Ready in 15 mins!

instructions.instruction: Heat oil, add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, and a pinch of asafoetida (hing).
Add chopped tomatoes, ginger, green chillies, turmeric, and jaggery/sugar for that signature Gujarati balance.
Simmer with half a cup of water until tomatoes soften into a juicy gravy.
Top generously with crispy sev right before taking off the flame. Serve with soft phulkas.

name: Traditional South Indian Sambar
description: Nutritious toor dal stew simmered with drumsticks, shallots, tamarind pulp, freshly ground sambar masala, and aromatic curry leaf tadka.

instructions.instruction: Cook toor dal with turmeric in a pressure cooker until soft; whisk well.
Boil vegetables (shallots, carrots, tomatoes) in tamarind water with sambar powder and salt.
Combine cooked dal with the vegetable-tamarind broth; bring to a boil.
Pour hot tempering of mustard seeds, fenugreek, dry red chillies, and curry leaves over the sambar.

name: Mysore Pepper Rasam
description: Soothing and digestive South Indian soup made with tomatoes, crushed black pepper, cumin seeds, garlic, tamarind, and aromatic coriander leaves.

instructions.instruction: Coarsely crush black peppercorns, cumin seeds, and garlic cloves in a mortar.
Boil chopped tomatoes with tamarind water, turmeric, and salt until soft.
Add the crushed pepper-cumin mixture and a little cooked dal water; let it froth gently.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in ghee, then garnish with plenty of coriander.

name: Spicy Veg Kolhapuri
description: Fiery Maharashtrian mixed vegetable curry packed with roasted desiccated coconut, sesame seeds, poppy seeds, and spicy Kolhapuri red masala.

instructions.instruction: Dry roast whole spices, dry coconut, sesame seeds, and chillies, then grind into Kolhapuri masala.
Steam diced carrots, beans, potatoes, and cauliflower until just tender.
Sauté chopped onions, ginger-garlic, and tomatoes with the ground Kolhapuri masala.
Toss in the steamed vegetables, simmer for 8 minutes to absorb spices, and garnish with coriander.

name: Paneer Lababdar
description: Rich restaurant style paneer curry with a chunky, silky tomato gravy, grated paneer for extra body, and aromatic kasuri methi.

instructions.instruction: Sauté whole spices with onions, tomatoes, and soaked cashews; cool and blend to a smooth paste.
In butter, cook finely chopped onions and capsicum for a signature chunky bite.
Pour in the blended makhani puree with coriander, cumin, and Kashmiri chilli powder.
Stir in paneer cubes, grated paneer, and fresh cream; simmer for 4 minutes.

name: Kadai Mushroom Masala
description: Juicy button mushrooms and crunchy bell peppers tossed in a spicy, freshly pounded coriander and red chilli kadai masala.

instructions.instruction: Dry roast coriander seeds, fennel, and dried red chillies; crush coarsely.
In hot oil, sauté bell peppers and onion petals on high heat for 2 minutes to keep crisp; set aside.
Cook chopped onions, tomatoes, and ginger-garlic paste until thick.
Add sliced mushrooms and the sautéed peppers with the crushed kadai masala; cook for 6 minutes.

name: Nawabi Vegetable Navratan Korma
description: Mild, sweet, and aromatic royal curry loaded with nine jewels (carrots, beans, peas, cauliflower, paneer, nuts, and pineapple) in cashew gravy.

instructions.instruction: Lightly steam assorted vegetables and shallow fry paneer cubes.
Blend boiled onions, cashews, and melon seeds with a hint of green cardamom into a white velvety paste.
Cook the velvety gravy in ghee on gentle heat, adding a splash of milk and cream.
Toss in the vegetables, paneer, and fried dry fruits; simmer for 5 minutes with saffron milk.

name: Punjabi Sarson Ka Saag with Makki Roti
description: Traditional slow-cooked Punjabi winter stew made from fresh mustard greens, spinach, and bathua tempered with white butter, garlic, and green chillies.

instructions.instruction: Wash mustard greens and spinach thoroughly, chop, and pressure cook with ginger and garlic.
Blend or mash using a traditional wooden masher, stirring in maize flour (makki atta) to thicken.
Simmer on low flame for 20 minutes to meld deep rustic earthy flavors.
Pour a sizzling hot tadka of pure ghee, garlic, and green chillies right on top.

name: Bottle Gourd Kofta Curry (Lauki Kofta)
description: Grated bottle gourd dumplings deep fried to golden lightness and simmered in a homestyle spiced onion-tomato curry.

instructions.instruction: Grate bottle gourd, squeeze out excess juice, mix with gram flour (besan), ajwain, and spices.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until crisp and golden brown.
Prepare onion, ginger-garlic, and tomato gravy in the pan.
Simmer koftas in gravy for 5 minutes so they soak up the flavors.

name: Mumbai Street Pav Bhaji
description: Iconic Mumbai street food: buttery, spiced vegetable mash of potatoes, peas, cauliflower, and tomatoes, served with toasted pav rolls and lemon.

instructions.instruction: Boil potatoes and green peas, then mash thoroughly with a potato masher.
On a wide tawa/pan, melt plenty of butter, add chopped onions, capsicum, and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes and pav bhaji masala; cook and mash continuously with water until thick and glossy.
Finish with a dollop of butter, coriander, and serve with hot butter-toasted pavs.

name: Spicy Kolhapuri Misal Pav
description: Fiery sprouted moth bean (matki) curry topped with spicy red rassa / kat gravy, crunchy farsan, chopped onions, and fresh lemon with pav.

instructions.instruction: Cook sprouted beans with turmeric and salt until tender.
Roast onions, dry coconut, and garlic into a fiery red misal masala paste.
Heat oil, add the paste and misal spices to create the signature oily red broth (kat / rassa).
Assemble: cooked sprouts in a bowl, ladle fiery rassa over top, garnish with crunchy farsan and raw onions.

name: Crispy Punjabi Aloo Samosa
description: Flaky pastry triangles filled with spiced potatoes, green peas, cumin, coriander seeds, and crushed ginger, fried to golden crispness.

instructions.instruction: Knead maida flour with carom seeds (ajwain), warm ghee, and water into a firm dough; rest 20 mins.
Sauté crushed ginger, green chillies, coriander seeds with boiled diced potatoes and peas.
Roll dough, cut into semicircles, shape into cones, fill with potato stuffing and seal edges with water.
Slow-fry in moderately hot oil for 12-15 minutes until pastry turns bubbly, flaky, and golden.

name: Crispy South Indian Medu Vada
description: Crispy on the outside, fluffy inside doughnut-shaped savory lentil fritters seasoned with black pepper, curry leaves, ginger, and cumin.

instructions.instruction: Grind soaked urad dal with minimal water into a fluffy, aerated batter.
Mix in chopped curry leaves, crushed black peppercorns, cumin, ginger, and green chillies.
Wet hands, shape dough into round patties with a center hole.
Drop into medium hot oil and deep fry until crispy and golden brown.

name: Crispy Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney
description: Golden fermented rice-lentil crepes filled with turmeric-spiced mashed potato filling, served with fresh coconut chutney and sambar.

instructions.instruction: Make the potato bhaji filling with boiled potatoes, mustard seeds, curry leaves, onions, and turmeric.
Heat a cast iron tawa, pour fermented dosa batter, and spread in quick concentric circles.
Drizzle butter/oil around edges and cook on medium flame until base turns crisp and golden.
Place potato masala in the center, roll the dosa, and serve piping hot.

name: Soft Steamed Idli with Sambar
description: Pillow-soft, light and fluffy steamed fermented rice and black lentil cakes, traditionally served for breakfast with coconut chutney.

instructions.instruction: Grease idli plates with a few drops of sesame oil.
Pour aerated fermented batter into molds.
Steam in idli cooker on medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes until clean toothpick comes out.
Cool for 2 minutes, scoop out with wet spoon and serve warm.

name: Maharashtra Kanda Poha (Flattened Rice with Onions)
description: Light, wholesome breakfast of flattened rice tossed with caramelized onions, mustard seeds, green chillies, roasted peanuts, and fresh lemon juice.

instructions.instruction: Rinse thick poha in a colander under running water for 30 seconds; drain completely.
In oil, crackle mustard seeds and roast peanuts until crunchy.
Add chopped onions, green chillies, turmeric, and curry leaves; sauté until soft.
Gently fold in softened poha, salt, sugar, and lemon juice. Steam covered for 2 minutes.

name: South Indian Rava Upma with Cashews
description: Savory semolina porridge tempered with mustard seeds, chana dal, grated ginger, vegetables, and roasted crunchy cashews in pure ghee.

instructions.instruction: Dry roast sooji / rava in a pan on medium flame until fragrant but not browned.
Heat ghee, temper mustard seeds, chana dal, cashews, ginger, and curry leaves.
Add water, salt, and green chillies; bring to a rolling boil.
Slowly pour roasted rava while stirring continuously to prevent lumps. Cover on low heat for 2 minutes.

name: Gujarati Methi Thepla
description: Soft and spiced whole wheat flatbreads kneaded with fresh fenugreek leaves, yogurt, sesame seeds, turmeric, and ajwain.

instructions.instruction: Mix finely chopped methi leaves, wheat flour, gram flour, yogurt, sesame seeds, and spices.
Knead with water and oil into a soft, pliable dough.
Roll out into thin round discs.
Cook on hot tawa with a few drops of oil on both sides until light brown spots appear.

name: Kolkata Paneer Kathi Roll
description: Crispy flaky paratha wrapped around tandoori marinated paneer cubes, crunchy onion rings, sliced capsicum, and tangy green mint chutney.

instructions.instruction: Marinate paneer cubes with red chilli, chaat masala, and lemon juice; pan-sear until charred.
Sauté onion slices and bell peppers for 2 minutes to keep crunch.
Warm or pan-cook flaky parathas with ghee on a tawa.
Spread mint chutney on paratha, line with paneer and onions, sprinkle chaat masala, and roll tightly in foil.

name: Mumbai Street Chicken Frankie Roll
description: Juicy spiced chicken tikka strips and masala onions rolled inside an egg-coated rumali or paratha, sprinkled with special frankie masala.

instructions.instruction: Sauté marinated chicken strips with onions, ginger-garlic, and chaat spices until tender.
Whisk 1 egg with salt; pour onto hot pan and immediately press paratha on top to stick.
Flip to cook egg layer until golden.
Fill egg paratha with cooked chicken, vinegar-pickled onions, frankie masala, and roll snugly.

name: Crispy Vegetable Cutlet / Patties
description: Golden spiced patties made of mashed potatoes, carrots, beetroot, and green peas, rolled in breadcrumbs and shallow fried until extra crunchy.

instructions.instruction: Mash boiled potatoes and mix with grated carrots, peas, garam masala, and chopped coriander.
Shape into oval cutlets, dip in thin cornstarch slurry, and coat with breadcrumbs.
Shallow fry in hot oil until both sides are deeply golden and crispy.
Serve piping hot with sweet date chutney and tangy mint sauce.

name: Mumbai Batata Vada
description: Mashed potato balls spiced with green chillies, garlic, mustard seeds, and curry leaves, coated in gram flour batter and deep fried to golden puffiness.

instructions.instruction: Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, crushed garlic, and green chillies; fold into mashed potatoes.
Make a smooth gram flour (besan) batter with turmeric and a pinch of baking soda.
Roll potato mix into rounds, dip into batter to coat completely.
Deep fry in medium hot oil until batter turns golden and crisp.

name: Soft Dahi Vada with Sweet Tamarind
description: Melt-in-the-mouth lentil dumplings soaked in chilled spiced sweet yogurt, topped with tangy tamarind chutney, mint chutney, and roasted cumin powder.

instructions.instruction: Whip urad dal batter until light; fry spoonfuls into golden round vadas.
Immerse fried vadas in warm salted water for 15 minutes, then gently squeeze out excess water.
Whisk chilled curd with a little powdered sugar and black salt until velvety.
Arrange vadas on a plate, pour sweet yogurt generously, drizzle tamarind and mint chutneys, and dust with roasted cumin.

name: Maharashtrian Sabudana Khichdi
description: Non-sticky tapioca pearls sautéed with roasted crushed peanuts, green chillies, diced potatoes, and cumin seeds in pure ghee.

instructions.instruction: Check soaked sabudana—pearls should mash easily between fingers without stickiness.
Heat ghee, add cumin seeds, chopped green chillies, and boiled potato cubes.
Toss in sabudana pearls, coarsely roasted peanuts, rock salt, and sugar.
Cover and cook on low heat for 2 minutes until pearls become translucent. Squeeze fresh lemon juice.

name: Authentic Thai Pad Thai with Peanuts
description: Street-style flat rice noodles stir-fried with eggs, bean sprouts, garlic chives, tangy tamarind sauce, and crushed roasted peanuts with lime.

instructions.instruction: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable.
Mix tamarind paste, soy sauce, brown sugar, and chilli flakes for the Pad Thai sauce.
Heat oil in a hot wok, push garlic to side, scramble 2 eggs until fluffy.
Add drained noodles and sauce; toss on high heat. Garnish with crushed peanuts and fresh lime.

name: Aromatic Thai Green Chicken Curry
description: Fragrant and creamy curry with tender chicken pieces, bamboo shoots, bell peppers, and fresh Thai basil simmered in rich coconut milk.

instructions.instruction: Fry green curry paste in coconut cream until fragrant and oil begins to separate.
Add sliced chicken breast pieces and sauté for 3 minutes.
Pour in remaining coconut milk, add bell peppers, and simmer gently for 8 minutes.
Tear in fresh basil leaves, season with soy sauce, and remove from heat.

name: Spicy Tom Yum Goong (Thai Prawn Soup)
description: Hot, sour, and invigorating clear Thai soup loaded with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, fresh prawns, and straw mushrooms.

instructions.instruction: Bring chicken or vegetable broth to a boil with smashed lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves.
Stir in Tom Yum chilli paste and sliced tomatoes.
Add fresh prawns; simmer for 3 minutes until prawns turn pink and juicy.
Turn off heat, stir in lime juice, soy sauce, and fresh coriander.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
description: Thailand's most popular street dish: minced chicken stir-fried at high heat with garlic, fiery bird's eye chillies, and fragrant holy basil, topped with a fried egg.

instructions.instruction: Pound garlic and green chillies coarsely in a mortar.
In a smoking hot wok, stir fry the garlic-chilli mix for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground or minced chicken; stir fry vigorously with soy sauce and dark soy sauce.
Turn off heat, toss in fresh basil leaves until wilted. Serve over rice with a crispy fried egg.

name: Szechuan Kung Pao Chicken
description: Wok-tossed chicken cubes with crunchy roasted peanuts, dry red chillies, garlic, and Szechuan peppercorns in a savory sweet-tangy sauce.

instructions.instruction: Marinate diced chicken with soy sauce and cornstarch for 10 minutes.
Whisk soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and chilli paste for the Kung Pao glaze.
Sear chicken cubes in a hot wok until golden; remove.
Fry dry chillies, garlic, and peanuts until aromatic; toss chicken back in with sauce until glossy.

name: Crispy Sweet and Sour Chicken
description: Bite-sized crispy chicken nuggets tossed with crunchy bell peppers, onions, and pineapple in an authentic glossy sweet and sour glaze.

instructions.instruction: Coat chicken pieces in egg and cornstarch; fry in hot oil until crispy golden.
Mix tomato paste, vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar to make the sweet and sour sauce.
Stir fry bell peppers and onions in a wok for 2 minutes to retain crunch.
Pour in sauce, thicken with cornstarch slurry, and toss the crispy chicken until coated.

name: Indo-Chinese Chicken Manchurian Gravy
description: Crispy chicken dumplings tossed in a rich, dark, garlicky Indo-Chinese gravy flavored with soy sauce, spring onions, and green chillies.

instructions.instruction: Season chicken cubes with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and cornstarch; fry till golden.
In wok, sauté heaps of finely chopped garlic, ginger, and green chillies for 1 minute.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and water; thicken with a light cornstarch slurry.
Add fried chicken and scallions, simmering for 2 minutes. Pair with fried rice.

name: Classic Veg Hakka Noodles
description: Smoky street-style stir-fried noodles with julienned cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, garlic, and scallions tossed with soy sauce and vinegar.

instructions.instruction: Boil noodles al dente, drain, rinse with cold water, and toss with 1 tsp oil.
Heat wok on high heat until smoking, add oil and minced garlic.
Toss shredded carrots, cabbage, and bell peppers on high heat for 2 minutes.
Add boiled noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper; toss vigorously for 2 minutes.

name: Fiery Schezwan Egg Fried Rice
description: Aromatic basmati or jasmine rice stir-fried with scrambled eggs, diced vegetables, and zesty homemade Schezwan chilli-garlic sauce.

instructions.instruction: Scramble eggs in a hot wok with salt and set aside.
Sauté chopped garlic, ginger, carrots, and bell peppers on high flame.
Add cold cooked rice, Schezwan sauce, and soy sauce.
Fold in scrambled eggs and scallions; toss on high heat until smoking hot.

name: Crispy Honey Chilli Potatoes
description: Crisp fried potato fingers tossed in a sticky, sweet and spicy glaze of honey, red chilli paste, garlic, and toasted sesame seeds.

instructions.instruction: Cut potatoes into fries, dust with cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Deep fry twice until potatoes are intensely golden and crackling crisp.
In a wok, cook garlic, chilli sauce, vinegar, and honey into a sticky glaze.
Toss hot crispy fries in the glaze with toasted sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: Steamed Himalayan Vegetable Momos
description: Delicate translucent steamed dumplings stuffed with finely minced seasoned cabbage, carrots, onions, garlic, and fresh herbs with spicy tomato dip.

instructions.instruction: Sauté finely grated cabbage, carrot, onion, and garlic with soy sauce for 2 minutes; cool.
Roll out thin dough wrappers, place stuffing in center, and pleat into pouches.
Place momos in a greased steamer basket.
Steam over boiling water for 10-12 minutes until wrappers turn glossy and translucent.

name: Classic Japanese Shoyu Chicken Ramen
description: Comforting noodle soup with savory soy-infused chicken broth, springy ramen noodles, tender sliced chicken, jammy soft-boiled egg, and scallions.

instructions.instruction: Simmer chicken broth with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and a dash of sesame oil.
Soft boil eggs for exactly 6.5 minutes, plunge into ice water, and peel.
Cook ramen noodles in boiling water for 3 minutes; drain.
Assemble: noodles in bowl, ladle hot broth over top, add sliced chicken and halved egg.

name: Japanese Chicken Teriyaki Donburi
description: Pan-seared tender chicken thighs glazed with a glossy, sweet-savory teriyaki sauce of soy sauce, mirin, and ginger, served over warm steamed rice.

instructions.instruction: Pan-sear chicken skin-side down until crispy and golden brown.
Flip chicken and cook through.
Pour in soy sauce, honey/sugar, and grated ginger; bubble until sauce forms a thick glaze coating chicken.
Slice chicken and serve over steamed rice bowl with toasted sesame seeds.

name: Korean Veggie & Egg Bibimbap
description: Colorful Korean rice bowl topped with seasoned sautéed spinach, carrots, mushrooms, cucumber, fried egg, and spicy fermented Gochujang sauce.

instructions.instruction: Sauté seasoned spinach with garlic and sesame oil; repeat with julienned carrots and cucumber.
Fry 2 sunny-side-up eggs with runny yolks.
Arrange warm rice in bowls, assemble vegetables neatly in sections on top.
Top with fried egg, spoonful of Gochujang sauce, and sesame seeds. Mix thoroughly before eating.

name: Silken Tofu & Wakame Miso Soup
description: Traditional soothing Japanese soup made with umami dashi broth, fermented soybean miso paste, silken tofu cubes, and green spring onions.

instructions.instruction: Heat water or vegetable broth in a pot to gentle simmer.
Add diced silken tofu and sliced mushrooms; simmer for 2 minutes.
Dissolve miso paste in a ladle with warm broth and stir into the soup. Do not boil once miso is added.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with chopped spring onions.

name: Neapolitan Margherita Pizza with Fresh Basil
description: Classic artisanal pizza with crispy wood-fired crust, crushed San Marzano tomato sauce, melted mozzarella, fresh basil, and extra virgin olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Stretch pizza dough into a 10-inch round leaving a puffy outer rim.
Spread crushed seasoned tomato sauce evenly over the dough base.
Tear fresh mozzarella cheese over sauce and drizzle extra virgin olive oil.
Bake at highest oven setting (250°C) on a preheated pizza stone for 8-10 mins. Top with fresh basil.

name: Creamy Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Al dente fettuccine ribbons tossed in a velvety homemade Parmesan cream sauce with tender seared garlic chicken breast and cracked pepper.

instructions.instruction: Boil fettuccine pasta in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Sear seasoned chicken breast in olive oil until golden and cooked through; slice.
Melt butter with minced garlic, add cream and simmer gently for 3 minutes.
Toss pasta and sliced chicken into sauce with grated cheese and fresh parsley.

name: Spicy Penne all'Arrabbiata with Basil
description: Classic Roman pasta tossed in an angry spicy tomato sauce with crushed garlic, fiery red chilli flakes, and extra virgin olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Boil penne pasta in salted water until al dente.
Heat olive oil in a skillet, gently sizzle minced garlic and red chilli flakes.
Add pureed crushed tomatoes, salt, and black pepper; simmer into a rich spicy sauce.
Toss drained penne into the sauce with a splash of pasta water and fresh basil.

name: Classic Baked Beef & Ricotta Lasagna
description: Decadent baked layered pasta with rich slow-cooked Bolognese meat ragù, creamy bechamel sauce, ricotta, and golden bubbly mozzarella.

instructions.instruction: Simmer meat with onions, garlic, carrots, tomatoes, and oregano into a deep rich Bolognese sauce.
Whisk butter, flour, and milk into a smooth creamy bechamel sauce.
Layer in baking dish: meat sauce, lasagna sheets, bechamel, and mozzarella.
Bake at 190°C for 35 minutes until bubbling and crust is golden brown.

name: Creamy Wild Mushroom Risotto (Risotto ai Funghi)
description: Creamy Arborio rice slowly stirred with warm vegetable broth, sautéed wild mushrooms, white wine reduction, butter, and aged Parmesan.

instructions.instruction: Sauté sliced mushrooms with garlic in butter until caramelized; set aside.
Toast Arborio rice in butter with finely chopped onions until translucent.
Ladle in hot broth one cup at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed before adding more.
Stir in the sautéed mushrooms, cold butter, and grated cheese off heat for mantecatura.

name: Spaghetti alla Carbonara with Eggs & Pepper
description: Authentic Roman pasta prepared without cream, utilizing eggs, crisp pancetta or bacon, pecorino cheese, and freshly cracked black pepper.

instructions.instruction: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Crisp bacon or pancetta in a skillet without extra oil.
Whisk 2 egg yolks and 1 whole egg with grated cheese and lots of black pepper.
Off heat, toss hot spaghetti with bacon and egg mixture with pasta water to emulsify into creamy sauce.

name: Pesto Genovese Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes
description: Vibrant green pasta tossed with fresh basil pesto, toasted pine nuts, extra virgin olive oil, and sweet blistered cherry tomatoes.

instructions.instruction: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/3 cup cooking water.
Blend fresh basil, garlic, pine nuts/walnuts, parmesan, and olive oil into pesto.
Blister cherry tomatoes in a pan with a drop of olive oil for 2 minutes.
Toss hot pasta with pesto and a splash of reserved water off heat, fold in blistered tomatoes.

name: Traditional Tuscan Minestrone Vegetable Soup
description: Hearty Italian rustic vegetable soup packed with zucchini, carrots, white beans, tomatoes, ditalini pasta, and fresh herbs.

instructions.instruction: Sauté diced onions, carrots, and celery in olive oil until tender.
Add garlic, oregano, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth; bring to a boil.
Add beans and small pasta shapes; simmer until pasta is al dente and soup is thick.
Stir in chopped spinach and finish with parmesan cheese and black pepper.

name: Crispy Garlic Tomato Bruschetta
description: Toasted rustic Italian country bread rubbed with raw garlic, topped with marinated ripe tomatoes, basil, and balsamic reduction.

instructions.instruction: Finely dice sweet tomatoes and toss with minced garlic, fresh basil, olive oil, and salt.
Toast thick crusty sourdough or baguette slices until golden and crisp.
Rub hot toasted bread surfaces with a halved garlic clove.
Spoon tomato mixture generously over bread and drizzle balsamic glaze.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmigiana (Melanzane alla Parmigiana)
description: Layers of roasted tender eggplant slices, rich tomato basil sauce, fresh mozzarella, and grated parmesan baked into a comforting casserole.

instructions.instruction: Slice eggplants, brush with olive oil and bake or grill until golden and soft.
Simmer a quick tomato sauce with garlic, basil, and olive oil.
Layer in a baking dish: tomato sauce, eggplant slices, mozzarella, and parmesan.
Bake at 200°C for 22 minutes until cheese is bubbly and lightly browned.

name: Pillow-Soft Potato Gnocchi in Gorgonzola Cream
description: Handmade fluffy potato gnocchi tossed in a decadent sauce of mild gorgonzola, cream, cracked black pepper, and toasted walnuts.

instructions.instruction: Boil potatoes, rice while hot, knead with flour and salt into soft pillowy gnocchi.
Boil gnocchi in salted water; remove as soon as they float to the surface.
Gently melt blue cheese/gorgonzola with cream and butter in a pan.
Toss floating gnocchi directly into the warm cream sauce with black pepper.

name: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Shells
description: Jumbo pasta shells loaded with creamy seasoned ricotta, sautéed baby spinach, and parmesan, baked over a marinara tomato bed.

instructions.instruction: Boil jumbo pasta shells al dente and rinse with cool water.
Wilt spinach in olive oil, squeeze dry, and mix with ricotta, parmesan, and nutmeg.
Spread tomato marinara on baking dish; stuff each shell and arrange neatly.
Bake at 190°C covered with foil for 20 mins, then uncovered for 5 mins until bubbling.

name: Middle Eastern Chicken Shawarma Plate
description: Spiced chicken marinated in cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, garlic, and lemon, grilled until charred and served with garlic toum and warm pita.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken thighs with cumin, paprika, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil for 20 mins.
Sear on high heat in a cast-iron skillet until well charred and cooked through.
Rest meat for 3 minutes, then slice into thin shawarma strips.
Serve with garlic sauce, pickled cucumbers, and warm flatbread.

name: Crispy Falafel Wrap with Tahini
description: Golden herbaceous chickpea patties seasoned with fresh parsley, coriander, and cumin, fried until crunchy and wrapped in pita with tahini.

instructions.instruction: Pulse soaked chickpeas, garlic, onion, cumin, coriander, and parsley in a food processor.
Shape into small patties and chill in fridge for 15 minutes to firm up.
Deep fry or air fry in hot oil until deeply golden and crispy.
Assemble in pita with cucumber slices, tomatoes, and drizzle creamy tahini.

name: Velvety Homemade Hummus with Olive Oil
description: Ultra-smooth chickpea dip whipped with tahini, freshly squeezed lemon juice, crushed garlic, and a pool of extra virgin olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Warm cooked chickpeas with a pinch of baking soda for 3 minutes to loosen skins.
Blend garlic, lemon juice, and tahini until thick and frothy.
Add warm chickpeas and ice cubes, blending on high for 5 minutes until velvet-smooth.
Spread into a shallow bowl, create swirls with a spoon, and pour generous extra virgin olive oil.

name: Greek Village Salad with Feta & Olives
