description: Crisp cucumbers, vine-ripened tomatoes, red onions, kalamata olives, and a slab of creamy Greek feta dusted with wild oregano and olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Chop ripe tomatoes and cucumbers into rustic bite-sized chunks.
Thinly slice red onion and toss with olives, salt, and red wine vinegar.
Combine in a salad bowl and top with a whole block of Greek feta cheese.
Drizzle liberally with extra virgin olive oil and dust with dry oregano.

name: Greek Chicken Gyros with Tzatziki
description: Herb-marinated grilled chicken strips wrapped in warm fluffy pita bread with fresh tomatoes, red onion slices, and cucumber-garlic tzatziki.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken strips with oregano, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil for 15 minutes.
Grate cucumber, squeeze dry, and mix with Greek yogurt, minced garlic, and dill for Tzatziki.
Grill chicken on high heat for 6-8 minutes until golden and charred.
Warm pita, layer with tzatziki, chicken, sliced tomatoes, and onions; wrap tightly.

name: Grilled Lebanese Shish Tawook Skewers
description: Juicy skewered chicken cubes marinated in yogurt, garlic, lemon, and tomato paste, grilled to smoky perfection.

instructions.instruction: Whisk yogurt with minced garlic, lemon juice, tomato paste, olive oil, and oregano.
Coat cubed chicken breasts in marinade for at least 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers with bell pepper and red onion squares.
Grill over high heat for 10-12 minutes, turning until charred and juicy.

name: Smoky Lebanese Baba Ganoush
description: Silky dip prepared from open-flame charred eggplants blended with tahini, fresh garlic, lemon juice, and extra virgin olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Roast whole eggplant over open flame until skin is completely blackened and flesh collapses.
Scoop out smoky pulp and drain excess water in a strainer for 5 minutes.
Mash pulp with garlic, tahini, lemon juice, and sea salt with a fork.
Plate in a dish, pour olive oil, and garnish with pomegranate arils and parsley.

name: Turkish Red Lentil Soup (Mercimek Çorbası)
description: Silky, warming soup of red lentils simmered with carrots, onions, and cumin, finished with sizzling aleppo pepper and mint butter.

instructions.instruction: Sauté chopped onion and carrot in butter until softened.
Add rinsed red lentils, cumin, tomato paste, and vegetable broth; bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes until lentils dissolve, then blend until silky smooth.
Melt butter with chilli flakes and dry mint; swirl on soup with a squeeze of fresh lemon.

name: Crispy Lebanese Fattoush Salad with Sumac
description: Crispy toasted pita chips tossed with cucumber, juicy tomatoes, radishes, fresh mint, and a zesty tart sumac pomegranate dressing.

instructions.instruction: Tear pita bread into pieces, toss with olive oil and bake until golden and crunchy.
Chop cucumber, tomatoes, and fresh mint leaves.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, sumac powder, and salt for the dressing.
Toss vegetables, crispy pita chips, and dressing together right before eating.

name: Moroccan Spiced Chickpea & Veggie Tagine
description: Slow-simmered Moroccan stew with chickpeas, carrots, potatoes, warm cinnamon, cumin, and dried apricots in rich spiced tomato sauce.

instructions.instruction: Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil with cinnamon, cumin, ginger, and turmeric.
Add diced carrots, potatoes, and tomatoes with a cup of broth.
Add chickpeas, cover, and gently simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are meltingly tender.
Garnish with toasted sliced almonds and fresh coriander.

name: Sizzling Mexican Chicken Fajitas
description: Tender marinated chicken breast strips seared on a smoking skillet with colorful bell peppers, red onions, lime, and warm tortillas.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken strips in lime juice, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic, and oil.
Sear chicken in a smoking hot cast-iron skillet for 6 minutes until charred; remove.
Toss sliced bell peppers and onions in the same skillet for 4 minutes until blistered.
Return chicken to skillet, squeeze fresh lime juice, and serve sizzling with warm tortillas.

name: Cheesy Chicken & Pepper Quesadilla
description: Crispy golden pan-toasted flour tortillas stuffed with seasoned shredded chicken, melted cheddar and mozzarella, and sautéed peppers.

instructions.instruction: Shred cooked chicken and toss with cumin, chilli powder, and diced bell peppers.
Place tortilla on skillet, cover half with shredded cheese and chicken filling.
Fold tortilla over and cook on medium heat until crispy golden underneath.
Flip carefully and toast the other side until cheese is completely melted and bubbly.

name: Carne Asada / Chicken Street Tacos
description: Charred spiced chicken thigh slices piled high on warm corn tortillas with freshly chopped cilantro, diced white onions, and lime wedges.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken in orange juice, lime, cumin, garlic, and chipotle spices.
Grill or pan-sear on high heat until well browned with crispy edges.
Chop chicken into small juicy bites.
Warm corn tortillas, spoon chicken in center, garnish with onion, coriander, and lime.

name: Loaded Black Bean & Rice Burrito Bowl
description: Wholesome Mexican fiesta bowl with cilantro-lime rice, seasoned black beans, sautéed corn, avocado slices, and fresh pico de gallo salsa.

instructions.instruction: Toss cooked warm rice with lime juice, zest, and chopped fresh coriander.
Warm black beans with cumin, garlic, and a splash of water for 5 minutes.
Chop tomatoes, red onion, green chillies, and coriander into a zesty pico de gallo.
Layer bowls with cilantro rice, beans, salsa, and drizzle with sour cream/curd.

name: Authentic Fresh Guacamole & Tortilla Chips
description: Creamy smashed ripe avocados with finely chopped tomatoes, red onions, jalapeños, cilantro, lime juice, and sea salt.

instructions.instruction: Cut avocados in half, remove pits, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Coarsely mash with a fork, leaving some pleasant chunky texture.
Fold in finely diced red onion, tomato, green chillies, and coriander.
Squeeze fresh lime juice, season with sea salt, and serve immediately with crunchy tortilla chips.

name: Hearty Chili con Carne with Beans
description: Slow-simmered rich Tex-Mex stew with minced beef/chicken, red kidney beans, tomatoes, smoked cumin, and dark chocolate for depth.

instructions.instruction: Brown minced meat with onions and garlic in a heavy pot until cooked.
Add chilli powder, cumin, oregano, and diced tomatoes.
Stir in kidney beans and broth; bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes until rich and thick.

name: Creamy Enchiladas Verdes
description: Rolled corn tortillas filled with shredded chicken, smothered in tangy salsa verde tomatillo sauce and melted cheese, baked to golden perfection.

instructions.instruction: Warm tortillas lightly in a pan so they roll without cracking.
Fill each tortilla with shredded seasoned chicken, roll up, and arrange seam-down in baking dish.
Pour tangy green salsa over top and sprinkle with plenty of cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 18 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbling.

name: Golden Cinnamon Sugar Mexican Churros
description: Crispy ridged fried pastry dough extruded through a star nozzle, dusted in cinnamon sugar, and served with warm spiced chocolate sauce.

instructions.instruction: Boil water, butter, and sugar in a saucepan; stir in flour until dough balls form.
Let cool slightly, beat in eggs one at a time until smooth choux dough forms.
Pipe through star nozzle into hot oil and fry until golden crisp on all sides.
Drain and immediately roll in cinnamon-sugar mixture.

name: Gourmet Smash Cheeseburger
description: Juicy, crispy-edged beef or chicken patty smashed thin on a searing griddle, with melted cheddar, caramelized onions, and house burger sauce.

instructions.instruction: Form meat into two loose round balls; season with salt and pepper.
Place on smoking cast iron skillet, smash hard with a heavy spatula until paper thin.
Cook 2 mins until edges brown deeply, flip, top with cheddar cheese, and cover with lid to melt.
Toast brioche buns in butter, spread burger sauce, stack patties with pickles and onions.

name: Crispy Buffalo Chicken Wings with Ranch
description: Extra crispy baked chicken wings tossed in a spicy, buttery Cayenne hot sauce glaze, served with cool ranch dressing and celery sticks.

instructions.instruction: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels; toss with baking powder and salt for extra crispiness.
Bake at 220°C on a wire rack for 35 minutes until deep golden and crunchy.
Melt butter and whisk with hot sauce and garlic powder.
Toss hot crispy wings in the warm buffalo sauce glaze and serve immediately with dip.

name: Creamy Three-Cheese Macaroni & Cheese
description: Elbow macaroni baked in an ultra-creamy cheese sauce of sharp cheddar, mozzarella, and parmesan, topped with golden buttered breadcrumbs.

instructions.instruction: Boil macaroni in salted water until al dente; drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, and gradually pour milk to form a smooth roux béchamel.
Turn off heat and stir in shredded cheeses until melted and velvety.
Fold in pasta, top with breadcrumbs, and bake at 200°C for 15 mins until bubbling and golden.

name: Traditional British Shepherd's Pie
description: Savory minced meat and vegetable filling with carrots and peas simmered in rich gravy, topped with fluffy piped mashed potatoes and baked till golden.

instructions.instruction: Boil potatoes and mash with butter, milk, and salt until fluffy.
Brown meat with onions, carrots, garlic, and rosemary.
Add broth and tomato paste; simmer until sauce is glossy and thick.
Spread meat in a baking dish, pipe mashed potatoes on top, and bake at 200°C for 20 mins until peaks brown.

name: Classic British Fish and Chips with Tartar Sauce
description: Tender flaky white fish in a bubbly, crispy golden batter, served with hot thick-cut potato chips and tangy caper tartar sauce.

instructions.instruction: Cut potatoes into thick chips; parboil and fry until golden crisp.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and cold soda water into a light airy batter.
Dust fish fillets in flour, dip in batter, and fry in hot oil at 180°C until deep golden.
Drain on paper towels, sprinkle sea salt, and serve with lemon wedges and tartar sauce.

name: Grilled Herb Chicken Breast with Steamed Veggies
description: Clean eating meal prep: tender chicken breast marinated in rosemary, garlic, and lemon, pan-grilled with steamed carrots and broccoli.

instructions.instruction: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness; season with olive oil, herbs, garlic, and lemon.
Grill on medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 74°C.
Steam carrots and veggies until tender-crisp; toss with salt and olive oil.
Rest chicken for 5 minutes before slicing so juices stay locked inside.

name: Classic Caesar Salad with Garlic Croutons
description: Crisp romaine lettuce hearts tossed in creamy Caesar dressing, crunchy homemade garlic croutons, cracked black pepper, and shaved parmesan.

instructions.instruction: Toss bread cubes with olive oil and garlic; bake until crispy golden croutons form.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, and parmesan into Caesar dressing.
Chop chilled crisp lettuce hearts and place in a large bowl.
Toss with dressing, top with crunchy croutons and shaved cheese.

name: Creamy Homestyle Potato Leek Soup (Vichyssoise)
description: Velvety smooth French soup of tender potatoes, sautéed leeks, fresh thyme, butter, and cream, served warm with crusty bread.

instructions.instruction: Melt butter in a soup pot, sauté sliced onions/leeks with garlic until soft without browning.
Add diced potatoes, vegetable broth, and thyme; bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are completely tender.
Blend until velvet-smooth, stir in cream, and season with salt and white pepper.

name: Telangana Sarva Pindi (Thapala Chekka)
description: The iconic pride of Telangana snacking — a crispy, savory, shallow-cooked skillet flatbread made from spiced rice flour, roasted peanuts, chana dal, sesame seeds, and curry leaves.

instructions.instruction: In a large mixing bowl, combine rice flour, roasted peanuts, soaked chana dal, white sesame seeds, finely chopped onions, green chillies, curry leaves, and ginger-garlic paste.
Add red chilli powder, cumin seeds, salt, and mix well. Gradually sprinkle warm water and knead into a soft, pliable dough.
Generously grease a deep heavy-bottomed kadai or flat pan with oil. Press a portion of dough evenly across the bottom and sides to form a thin flatbread.
Make small holes throughout the pressed dough and pour a drop of oil into each hole for maximum crispness.
Cover with lid and cook on medium-low flame for 10-12 minutes until bottom turns golden-brown and crispy. Serve hot with butter or chutney.

name: Authentic Telangana Pachi Pulusu
description: A legendary uncooked rustic tamarind rasam from rural Telangana, made with charred green chillies, raw onions, fragrant cumin-mustard tadka, and a touch of jaggery.

instructions.instruction: Soak tamarind in 1.5 cups of warm water for 10 minutes and extract smooth, tangy tamarind juice into a clay or ceramic bowl.
Roast or char whole green chillies directly on an open flame until slightly blistered and fragrant, then mash them coarsely with salt and jaggery.
Add thinly sliced raw onions, crushed chillies, and finely chopped coriander to the tamarind water. Stir until jaggery dissolves.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan. Splutter mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dry red chillies, turmeric, and curry leaves.
Pour the sizzling tadka directly into the tamarind bowl. Do NOT boil. Serve at room temperature with hot rice and potato fry!

name: Telangana Bagara Rice
description: The celebratory spiced rice of Telangana festivals and weddings, cooked with whole spices, shahjeera, mint, and caramelised onions without turmeric.

instructions.instruction: Wash basmati or sona masoori rice thoroughly and soak in clean water for 20 minutes.
Heat ghee and oil in a heavy pot. Add whole spices: shahjeera, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, and bay leaves until aromatic.
Add sliced onions and green chillies. Sauté until onions are translucent and lightly golden brown.
Stir in freshly ground ginger-garlic paste, fresh mint leaves, and coriander. Sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Drain and add the soaked rice. Gently stir for 1 minute to coat with ghee and spices.
Add 3.5 cups of boiling water and salt. Cover and simmer on low flame for 12-14 minutes until rice is fluffy and tender.

name: Telangana Makka Garelu (Corn Vada)
description: Rustic monsoon fritters from rural Telangana made by coarsely grinding fresh sweet corn cobs with green chillies, garlic, and cumin, fried till crunchy.

instructions.instruction: Separate corn kernels from fresh cobs. Grind coarsely without adding any water along with green chillies, garlic, and cumin seeds.
Transfer to a bowl. Mix in finely chopped onions, fresh coriander, curry leaves, and salt until a shapeable batter forms.
Heat cooking oil in a deep kadai over medium flame.
Take small portions of corn batter, flatten lightly on your palm into round vadas, and slide gently into hot oil.
Fry on medium heat for 4-5 minutes, turning occasionally until golden brown and super crispy. Serve with spicy chutney or tea.

name: Telangana Golichina Mamsam (Spicy Mutton Fry)
description: A fiery, slow-roasted Telangana dry mutton specialty simmered with iron-rich spices, garlic, curry leaves, and rustic Telangana garam masala.

instructions.instruction: Pressure cook washed mutton pieces with turmeric, salt, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, and 1/2 cup water for 4 whistles until 80% tender.
Heat oil in a heavy cast-iron kadai. Add slit green chillies, sliced onions, and lots of fresh curry leaves. Sauté till golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté until raw aroma dissipates.
Add cooked mutton along with any remaining broth. Fry on high heat until the moisture evaporates.
Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, and Telangana garam masala. Slow roast (golinchadam) on low flame for 10-12 minutes until oil coats the dark browned meat.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with hot rice or Jonna Rotte.

name: Telangana Natu Kodi Pulusu (Country Chicken Stew)
description: Traditional village-style country chicken stew simmered with rich poppy seeds (gasagasalu), roasted coconut, garlic, and fiery red chillies.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken pieces with turmeric, red chilli powder, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for 15 minutes.
Grind soaked poppy seeds, dry coconut, and coriander seeds with water into a fine aromatic spice paste.
Heat oil in a heavy pot. Add onions, green chillies, and curry leaves; sauté until deep golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft and pulpy.
Add marinated chicken and sear on high heat for 5 minutes. Pour in the ground poppy-seed paste and 2 cups of water.
Cover and simmer on low-medium flame for 20 minutes until chicken is tender and spicy red oil floats on top. Serve with Bagara rice!

name: Telangana Jonna Rotte (Sorghum / Jowar Roti)
description: The ancient nutritious staple flatbread of Telangana villages, hand-patted and baked over a blazing tawa. Naturally gluten-free, diabetic-friendly, and high in fiber.

instructions.instruction: Bring 1 cup of water with a pinch of salt to a rolling boil in a saucepan.
Pour boiling water gradually into jowar (sorghum) flour in a wide basin. Mix with a spatula, then knead vigorously with warm hands for 5 minutes until soft and elastic.
Pinch a lemon-sized ball of dough. Dust rolling board with flour. Use flat palms to gently tap and pat the dough into a thin round circular roti.
Transfer gently onto a smoking hot iron tawa. Wet your palm with water and spread evenly over the top surface of the roti.
Flip after 30 seconds and cook other side until brown spots appear and roti puffs up like a balloon. Serve hot with spicy curry or pachadi.

name: Telangana Tomato Biryani / Tahari
description: A comforting, rich rustic one-pot rice specialty layered with spiced tomatoes, potatoes, onions, mint, and hearty Telangana seasonings.

instructions.instruction: Wash and soak 1.5 cups of rice in water for 15 minutes.
Heat 2.5 tbsp oil in a pressure cooker. Add cumin seeds, cloves, cinnamon, and sliced onions; sauté until translucent.
Add ginger-garlic paste, green chillies, mint, and cubed potatoes. Sauté for 2 minutes.
Add plenty of ripe chopped tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder, and garam masala. Cook until tomatoes breakdown into a rich gravy.
Add drained rice, 2.5 cups water, and salt. Stir gently, seal cooker, and cook for 2 whistles.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff gently, and garnish with fresh coriander. Serve with onion raita!

name: Telangana Pappu Chaaru
description: Thin, aromatic, soul-soothing lentil and tamarind stew with crushed garlic, curry leaves, onions, and ripe tomatoes.

instructions.instruction: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and a drop of oil for 3 whistles until soft, then mash smoothly with a whisk.
In a large pot, combine mashed dal, tamarind water, sliced onions, tomatoes, slit green chillies, and salt.
Add 2.5 cups of water and simmer on medium flame for 10 minutes until raw tamarind taste disappears.
In a small tadka pan, heat oil. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, crushed garlic pods, dry red chillies, and curry leaves until fragrant and garlic turns golden.
Pour the hot sizzling tadka into the boiling chaaru. Cover immediately to lock in the aroma. Garnish with coriander.

name: Telangana Rail Palaram (Steamed Rice Kudumulu)
description: Traditional steamed savory rice flour pearls tempered with chana dal, mustard, cumin, green chillies, and curry leaves. Zero oil, healthy, and light.

instructions.instruction: Boil 1.5 cups water with 1 tsp oil and salt. Slowly add rice flour while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
Cover and let it rest on low flame for 2 minutes. Turn off heat and allow to cool slightly.
Knead the warm dough and roll into bite-sized small round marble balls (kudumulu).
Steam the balls in an idli steamer or colander for 8-10 minutes until glossy and cooked through.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Splutter mustard seeds, cumin seeds, soaked chana dal, green chillies, and curry leaves. Toss the steamed rice balls in the tempering for 2 minutes and serve!

name: Telangana Gongura Chicken (Puntikura Kodi)
description: Spicy chicken cooked in tart sorrel leaves (gongura / puntikura), garlic, and caramelized onions — an unforgettable Andhra & Telangana specialty.

instructions.instruction: Wash fresh gongura leaves thoroughly. Sauté in 1 tsp oil with 2 green chillies for 4 minutes until wilted, then mash into a coarse tangy paste.
Heat 2.5 tbsp oil in a kadai. Sauté sliced onions until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute.
Add chicken pieces, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cook on high heat for 5 minutes until chicken turns white.
Cover with lid and cook on medium flame for 12 minutes in its own juices until chicken is 90% tender.
Add the prepared gongura paste, garam masala, and 1/2 cup water. Simmer on low heat for 6-8 minutes until thick, spicy, and tangy.

name: Telangana Malidalu (Jaggery & Roti Sweet Balls)
description: Wholesome, traditional Telangana sweet balls made by pulverizing fresh or leftover chapatis with grated jaggery, pure ghee, and roasted sesame seeds.

instructions.instruction: Tear warm fresh whole wheat rotis/chapatis into small shreds.
In a mixer grinder or traditional pestle, coarsely pulse the roti shreds with grated organic jaggery and a pinch of cardamom powder.
Transfer to a mixing bowl. Add dry roasted white sesame seeds and melted warm ghee.
Mix well while warm and shape into tight round laddoos (malidalu). Store in an airtight container or enjoy warm immediately.

name: Anapakaya Paalu Kura (Bottle Gourd in Milk Stew)
description: A comforting, mildly spiced Telangana home-cooked curry where tender bottle gourd cubes are simmered softly in seasoned milk and cumin-mustard tempering.

instructions.instruction: Peel bottle gourd, discard fibrous center, and cut into bite-sized 1-inch cubes.
Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in a pan. Splutter mustard seeds, cumin seeds, slit green chillies, and curry leaves.
Add chopped onions and turmeric; sauté for 2 minutes until translucent.
Add diced bottle gourd and salt. Sauté for 2 minutes, add 1/4 cup water, cover, and cook until bottle gourd is fork-tender.
Lower heat to the lowest setting. Pour in warm boiled milk. Simmer gently for 3-4 minutes while stirring gently so milk doesn’t curdle. Serve warm with rice or roti.

name: Telangana Bendakaya Pulusu (Okra Tamarind Stew)
description: Crisp sautéed okra simmered in a luscious sweet-and-sour tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies, curry leaves, and a touch of jaggery.

instructions.instruction: Wash, dry completely, and cut ladyfinger (bendakaya) into 1.5-inch pieces.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan and shallow fry okra pieces on medium-high heat for 5 minutes until sliminess is gone. Set aside.
In the same pan, heat remaining oil. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, sliced onions, and green chillies; sauté until translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cook until soft.
Add tamarind extract, 1 cup water, jaggery, and sautéed okra. Simmer on medium-low flame for 8 minutes until gravy thickens slightly. Serve with steamed rice!

name: Telangana Miryala Charu (Pepper Garlic Rasam)
description: An invigorating, peppery, immunity-boosting digestive rasam made with coarsely crushed black peppercorns, roasted whole garlic cloves, and tangy tamarind.

instructions.instruction: Coarsely crush black peppercorns, cumin seeds, and 6 garlic cloves using a mortar and pestle.
In a pot, combine tamarind extract, 2 cups of water, chopped tomato, turmeric, and salt.
Bring to a rolling boil and simmer for 5 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Add the crushed pepper-garlic mixture and fresh coriander; simmer for just 2 more minutes.
In a tadka ladle, heat 1 tsp ghee/oil with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and dry red chilli. Pour into the charu and cover immediately.

name: Telangana Kandi Pachadi (Roasted Toor Dal Chutney)
description: A thick, rustic roasted lentil chutney ground coarsely with dry red chillies, garlic, and tamarind. Best served warm mixed with steaming hot rice and pure ghee.

instructions.instruction: Dry roast toor dal in a pan on medium-low flame for 6-7 minutes until aromatic and reddish-golden brown. Transfer to a plate to cool.
In the same pan, heat 1 tsp oil and roast dry red chillies, cumin seeds, and garlic pods for 2 minutes.
Transfer roasted ingredients to a mixer grinder along with soaked tamarind, salt, and 1/4 cup warm water. Grind into a coarse, thick paste (not too smooth).
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in 1 tsp oil. Mix into the pachadi and serve with hot rice!

name: Gutti Vankaya Batani Kura (Stuffed Brinjal & Peas)
description: Small tender purple brinjals stuffed with a flavorful roasted peanut, sesame, and spice paste, braised in a rich gravy with sweet green peas.

instructions.instruction: Roast peanuts, sesame seeds, coriander seeds, and cumin seeds until fragrant. Grind with ginger, garlic, red chilli powder, turmeric, and a little water into a thick masala paste.
Slit brinjals into four quarters from the bottom, keeping stalks intact. Stuff the prepared masala firmly inside each brinjal.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wide heavy pan. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and sliced onions; sauté until onions soften.
Gently place stuffed brinjals in the pan and sear on medium heat for 5 minutes, turning carefully.
Add green peas, any leftover masala paste, 1 cup of water, and salt. Cover with lid and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until brinjals are buttery tender and gravy is thick and glossy.

name: Alugadda Vepudu (Telangana Style Potato Roast)
description: Crispy cubed potatoes slow-roasted with green chillies, golden garlic, fresh curry leaves, and fragrant spices — the ultimate everyday comfort side.

instructions.instruction: Peel and cut potatoes into uniform 0.75-inch cubes. Soak in cold salted water for 5 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
Heat 2.5 tbsp oil in a heavy-bottomed iron skillet over medium heat.
Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, crushed garlic cloves, slit green chillies, and fresh curry leaves; let them crackle.
Add diced potatoes, turmeric, and salt. Sauté on medium-high heat for 3 minutes.
Lower heat, cover with lid and cook for 8 minutes until potatoes are soft inside.
Remove lid, sprinkle red chilli powder, and roast on medium-high flame for 4 minutes until exterior turns golden and crisp. Serve with Pappu Chaaru!

name: Telangana Kodi Vepudu (Spicy Chicken Roast)
description: Bone-in chicken pieces stir-fried on high flame with caramelized onions, fresh green chillies, garlic, and coarse ground Telangana spices.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken pieces with turmeric, 1 tsp red chilli powder, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a heavy kadai. Add thinly sliced onions and sauté on medium heat until golden brown.
Add slit green chillies, curry leaves, and marinated chicken. Stir-fry on high flame for 5 minutes to sear in flavors.
Cover and simmer on medium-low flame for 12 minutes in its own moisture until chicken is cooked through.
Uncover, sprinkle remaining red chilli powder, garam masala, and black pepper. Roast on high flame for 4 minutes until juices reduce and coat chicken with a glistening spice crust.

name: Telangana Egg Pulusu (Kodi Guddu Pulusu)
description: Golden shallow-fried boiled eggs simmered in a pungent, sweet-tangy tamarind broth with tender onions, green chillies, and aromatic tempering.

instructions.instruction: Hard-boil 4 eggs, peel shells, and make slight surface slits. Toss in 1 tsp oil with a pinch of turmeric and chilli powder for 2 minutes until blistered.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan. Splutter mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, and sliced onions; sauté until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, turmeric, and salt; cook until oil separates.
Add tamarind extract, 1 cup water, and 1 tsp jaggery. Bring to a vigorous boil.
Drop in fried eggs. Simmer on low heat for 7 minutes so the eggs absorb the tangy gravy. Garnish with coriander.

name: Telangana Dosakaya Pappu (Yellow Cucumber Dal)
description: A comforting Telangana & Andhra dal prepared with sour yellow cucumber cubes simmered into creamy toor dal, finished with sizzling garlic tadka.

instructions.instruction: Taste dosakaya (yellow cucumber) to ensure it is not bitter. Peel, deseed, and dice into 1-inch cubes.
In a pressure cooker, add washed toor dal, diced dosakaya, chopped tomato, green chillies, turmeric, and 2 cups water. Cook for 3 whistles.
Once pressure releases, open and mash dal gently. Add salt and a small piece of soaked tamarind if dosakaya is not sour enough.
Heat oil in a small pan. Splutter mustard seeds, cumin seeds, crushed garlic cloves, dry red chillies, and curry leaves.
Pour hot tempering over dal, stir well, and simmer for 2 minutes. Serve with hot rice and ghee.

name: Telangana Sakinalu (Crisp Sesame Rice Spirals)
description: Crispy, golden concentric circular fried snacks prepared during Telangana Sankranti festival using freshly ground wet rice flour, sesame seeds, and carom seeds.

instructions.instruction: In a wide plate, mix rice flour, abundant white sesame seeds, carom seeds (ajwain), and salt.
Sprinkle water gradually and knead into a soft, non-sticky dough.
Spread a clean cotton cloth. Take small dough portions between fingers and pipe into concentric spiral rings directly on the cloth.
Heat oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
Gently lift dried spiral rings using a flat spatula and slide into hot oil. Fry on medium flame until crisp and pale golden. Cool completely and store in airtight jars.

name: Menthi Kura Pappu (Fenugreek Leaves Dal)
description: Iron-rich, nutritious Telangana homestyle toor dal simmered with fresh tender methi leaves, tomatoes, green chillies, and fragrant roasted garlic.

instructions.instruction: Pluck and thoroughly wash fresh fenugreek (methi) leaves to remove grit. Chop finely.
In a pressure cooker, cook toor dal with chopped methi leaves, tomatoes, green chillies, turmeric, and 2 cups water for 3 whistles.
Mash cooked dal gently. Stir in salt and a marble-sized extract of tamarind juice.
Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in a tadka pan. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, lots of crushed garlic cloves, and curry leaves; fry until garlic turns golden brown.
Pour the sizzling garlic tadka into the dal. Simmer on low heat for 2 minutes and serve warm with rice.

name: Telangana Potlakaya Perugu Pachadi
description: Refreshing cooling pachadi prepared by folding tender sauteed snake gourd pieces into creamy spiced curd with mustard-ginger tempering.

instructions.instruction: Scrape outer skin of snake gourd (potlakaya), cut in half, scrape out seeds, and chop finely into small pieces.
Heat 1 tsp oil in a pan. Add chopped snake gourd, green chillies, and a pinch of salt. Sauté for 5-6 minutes until tender and cooked through. Let it cool.
Whisk 1 cup of fresh thick curd/yogurt smoothly with salt in a bowl.
Fold cooled snake gourd pieces into the whisked curd.
Heat 1 tsp oil. Splutter mustard seeds, cumin seeds, grated ginger, curry leaves, and dry red chillies. Pour over pachadi and mix well!

name: Telangana Tomato Mirchi Kura
description: A fiery, rustic everyday Telangana quick curry made with abundant juicy tomatoes, slit hot green chillies, garlic, and cumin tempering. Ready in 15 minutes with pure pantry staples.

instructions.instruction: Chop 4 ripe tomatoes and slit 5 spicy green chillies lengthwise.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan. Splutter cumin seeds, mustard seeds, and crushed garlic cloves until aromatic.
Add sliced onions, green chillies, and curry leaves. Sauté for 3 minutes until onions turn soft.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until tomatoes breakdown into a rich juicy gravy.
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander. Serve hot with Jowar Roti, Chapati, or steamed rice!

name: French Butter Rolled Omelette
description: Classic Parisian soft and velvety folded omelette with fresh herbs, chives, and creamy butter.

instructions.instruction: Crack 3 eggs into a bowl with a pinch of salt and black pepper; whisk vigorously until completely homogeneous.
Melt generous butter in an 8-inch non-stick skillet over medium-low heat until foaming.
Pour in eggs and shake pan while stirring rapidly in small circles with a spatula until soft curds form.
Tilt skillet, gently roll into an almond cylinder shape, and slide onto a warm plate with fresh chives.

name: Classic Soft Scrambled Eggs with Buttered Toast
description: Luxurious creamy scrambled eggs cooked slowly over gentle heat, served atop crisp golden toasted bread.

instructions.instruction: Whisk eggs with a splash of milk, salt, and freshly cracked black pepper.
Melt butter in a skillet over low heat and pour in egg mixture.
Gently sweep spatula across the pan creating soft, creamy folds. Remove just before set.
Toast bread slices until golden brown; butter generously and spoon hot scrambled eggs on top.

name: Street Style Mumbai Egg Bhurji
description: Fiery scrambled eggs tossed with finely chopped onions, juicy tomatoes, slit green chillies, and aromatic cumin.

instructions.instruction: Heat oil or butter in a pan; add cumin seeds and sauté chopped onions, ginger, and green chillies until translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes turn mushy.
Crack eggs directly into the masala or whisk beforehand. Scramble vigorously over medium-high heat until cooked.
Finish with chopped fresh coriander and squeeze fresh lemon juice. Serve hot with pav or roti.

name: Cheesy Egg-in-a-Hole (Toad in the Hole)
description: Fun and crispy breakfast bread with a sunny egg cooked directly inside the center cutout, topped with melted cheese.

instructions.instruction: Cut a 2-inch circle from the center of bread slice using a biscuit cutter or glass rim.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat; place bread slice and the cutout circle into the pan.
Crack egg directly into the center hole. Season with salt, pepper, and top with cheese.
Flip gently once the bottom is golden and egg white is partially set. Cook for 2 more minutes.

name: Classic Golden French Toast with Honey & Cinnamon
description: Thick slices of bread dipped in a rich spiced egg-milk batter and pan-fried golden brown with honey.

instructions.instruction: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon powder, and a teaspoon of honey or sugar in a wide shallow bowl.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium flame.
Dip bread slices in the egg mixture for 15 seconds per side until soaked but not soggy.
Cook slices in the pan for 3 minutes per side until golden brown and puffed. Drizzle honey and serve warm.

name: Dhaba Style Egg Curry
description: Boiled eggs lightly fried with turmeric and simmered in a spiced onion, tomato, ginger-garlic gravy.

instructions.instruction: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, peel, make shallow slits, and pan-fry in oil with a pinch of turmeric until golden.
In same pan, sauté cumin seeds, chopped onions, and ginger-garlic paste until deeply browned.
Stir in tomato puree, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, and salt; cook until oil releases.
Pour 1 cup water, drop in fried eggs, simmer for 5 minutes, and garnish with fresh coriander.

name: Creamy Egg Salad Sandwich
description: Hard-boiled eggs diced and mixed with creamy mayo or hung curd, mustard, black pepper, and crisp celery on toast.

instructions.instruction: Roughly chop hard-boiled eggs into small uniform cubes.
In a bowl, mix eggs with mayonnaise or yogurt, mustard, black pepper, and chopped onions.
Toast bread slices lightly until crisp.
Spread generous egg salad filling between bread slices, slice diagonally, and enjoy.

name: Spicy Boiled Egg Pepper Fry
description: Hard boiled egg halves tossed on a tawa with caramelized onions, curry leaves, crushed garlic, and black pepper.

instructions.instruction: Cut hard boiled eggs lengthwise into halves.
Heat oil in a flat pan; splutter mustard seeds, curry leaves, and lots of sliced onions and garlic.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, and lots of freshly crushed black pepper with salt.
Place egg halves face down, spoon the spicy onion-pepper masala on top, and roast for 4 minutes until crisp.

name: Fiery Egg Fried Rice
description: Cold cooked basmati rice wok-tossed with fluffy scrambled eggs, garlic, spring onions, and spicy soy seasoning.

instructions.instruction: Beat 2 eggs with a pinch of salt. Scramble in a smoking hot wok with 1 tsp oil until just set; set aside.
Add remaining oil; stir-fry minced garlic, onions, and green chillies for 1 minute.
Add chilled cooked rice and toss vigorously on high heat for 2 minutes.
Fold in scrambled eggs, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. Toss on blazing flame for 2 minutes and garnish with spring onions.

name: Mediterranean Shakshuka with Poached Eggs
description: Silky spiced stew of simmering tomatoes, sweet bell peppers, onions, and cumin with soft eggs poached right in the sauce.

instructions.instruction: Heat olive oil in a skillet; sauté chopped onions, minced garlic, and diced bell peppers for 5 minutes until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 8 minutes until a thick rich sauce forms.
Make 3 small wells in the sauce with a spoon; crack an egg directly into each well.
Cover skillet with a lid and cook on low heat for 5 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny. Garnish with coriander.

name: Pan-Seared Garlic Lemon Butter Chicken
description: Succulent tender chicken breasts seared in a skillet with sizzling garlic, fresh lemon juice, butter, and cracked pepper.

instructions.instruction: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness; season both sides with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through (165°F internally).
Add minced garlic, remaining butter, and fresh lemon juice; baste chicken with the bubbling sauce for 2 minutes.

name: Crispy Garlic Chicken Stir-Fry with Bell Peppers
description: Juicy chicken cubes flash-fried in a hot wok with crunchy capsicum, sliced onions, and savory soy garlic sauce.

instructions.instruction: Cut boneless chicken into bite-sized cubes. Toss with salt, pepper, and 1 tsp cornstarch or flour.
Heat oil in a wok until smoking hot. Sear chicken pieces for 5 minutes until golden; remove and set aside.
In the same wok, toss sliced bell peppers, onions, and minced garlic on high heat for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return chicken to pan, add soy sauce or seasonings, toss vigorously for 1 minute, and garnish with spring onions.

name: Classic Indian Chicken Curry
description: Homestyle aromatic chicken curry prepared with tender bone-in chicken simmered in a spiced onion tomato gravy.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken pieces with turmeric, salt, and ginger-garlic paste for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a heavy pot; sauté sliced onions with whole spices until deeply caramelized.
Add chopped tomatoes, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and cook until oil separates.
Add marinated chicken; sear on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 1 cup water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.

name: Chicken Alfredo Penne Pasta
description: Al dente penne pasta and sliced seared chicken breast coated in a velvety garlic parmesan cream sauce.

instructions.instruction: Boil penne pasta in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente; drain and reserve half cup pasta water.
Season chicken breast with salt and pepper; sear in butter for 6 minutes per side until cooked, then slice into strips.
In same pan, sauté minced garlic in butter; pour in cream/milk and simmer gently until thickened.
Toss pasta and sliced chicken in the rich sauce with cheese and black pepper. Garnish with parsley.

name: Quick Cheesy Chicken Quesadilla
description: Pan-crisped tortillas or flatbreads loaded with shredded seasoned chicken, onions, melted cheese, and green chillies.

instructions.instruction: Shred cooked chicken or pan-fry chicken strips with cumin, chilli powder, salt, and diced onions.
Heat a dry skillet over medium heat; place tortilla or flatbread and scatter shredded cheese on one half.
Top cheese with seasoned chicken, diced green chillies, fold the other half over, and press down.
Cook for 3 minutes per side until tortilla is golden-brown crisp and cheese is completely melted.

name: Chicken Fried Rice (Takeout Style)
description: Fragrant jasmine or basmati rice stir-fried in a blazing hot wok with tender chicken, scrambled egg, and scallions.

instructions.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame. Cook diced chicken pieces for 4 minutes until golden; push to the side.
Crack egg directly into the wok and scramble softly.
Add chilled cooked rice, diced carrots, onions, and minced garlic.
Drizzle 2 tbsp soy sauce and pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes until aromatic and slightly smoky.

name: Honey Garlic Pan Chicken
description: Crispy pan-fried chicken bites coated in a sticky, sweet and savory honey garlic butter glaze.

instructions.instruction: Cut boneless chicken into bite-sized nuggets; season with salt and pepper.
Sear chicken in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked and browned.
Reduce flame; add 1 tbsp butter, 6 minced garlic cloves, 3 tbsp honey, and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Simmer glaze rapidly for 2 minutes until bubbling and caramelized around the chicken. Sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: Classic Chicken Clear Soup
description: Nourishing comforting broth simmered with tender chicken, sliced carrots, crushed ginger, garlic, and cracked pepper.

instructions.instruction: In a soup pot, heat 1 tsp butter; add crushed ginger and garlic; sauté for 1 minute.
Add chicken pieces, sliced carrots, onions, and 4 cups water or broth.
Bring to boil; skim foam, then simmer on low heat for 12 minutes until chicken is tender.
Season with salt and lots of freshly crushed black pepper. Garnish with coriander and serve steaming hot.

name: Restaurant Style Paneer Butter Masala
description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a silky, rich, mildly sweet tomato-butter gravy scented with kasuri methi.

instructions.instruction: Puree boiled ripe tomatoes with ginger, garlic, and cashews into a smooth silky paste.
Heat butter and oil in a pan; add whole spices, turmeric, and Kashmiri red chilli powder for vibrant color.
Pour in tomato puree; cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until thickened and oil floats on top.
Add fresh paneer cubes, cream, salt, and crushed kasuri methi. Simmer gently for 4 minutes.

name: Homestyle Paneer Bhurji
description: Crumbled fresh paneer sautéed with caramelized onions, tangy tomatoes, green chillies, and fragrant spices.

instructions.instruction: Heat oil or butter in a pan. Splutter cumin seeds and sauté chopped onions and ginger-garlic until translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes, green chillies, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cook until mushy.
Crumble fresh paneer with your fingers and fold into the spiced tomato-onion masala.
Cook for just 3 minutes so paneer stays soft and moist. Garnish with chopped coriander and serve with roti.

name: Classic Palak Paneer (Spinach Cottage Cheese)
description: Fresh vibrant spinach blanched and pureed into a velvety spiced garlic gravy with tender golden-seared paneer cubes.

instructions.instruction: Blanch fresh spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes; immediately plunge into ice-cold water and blend to a smooth puree.
Heat oil in a pan; fry paneer cubes lightly for 2 minutes until pale golden and set aside.
In same pan, sauté cumin, lots of chopped garlic, onions, and green chillies until fragrant.
Add pureed spinach, salt, garam masala, and fried paneer cubes. Simmer for 4 minutes and finish with butter.

name: Kadai Paneer with Bell Peppers & Onions
description: Paneer cubes and crunchy bell pepper petals tossed in a spicy, freshly pounded coriander-red chilli kadai masala.

instructions.instruction: Dry roast coriander seeds and dry red chillies; grind coarsely into kadai masala.
Heat oil in a kadai; toss cubed capsicum and onion petals on high heat for 3 minutes until crisp-tender; set aside.
In same kadai, cook onion-tomato puree with ginger-garlic paste and kadai masala until fragrant.
Fold in paneer cubes and sautéed bell peppers. Simmer for 3 minutes and garnish with fresh ginger juliennes.

name: Crispy Chilli Paneer (Indo-Chinese Wok)
description: Golden batter-crisped paneer cubes tossed in a sizzling wok with dark soy, chilli sauce, diced bell peppers, and spring onions.

instructions.instruction: Cut paneer into cubes; coat in a light dusting of flour, cornstarch, salt, and black pepper.
Shallow fry paneer in 2 tbsp oil on high flame until crisp and golden on all sides; remove.
In same pan, flash-fry minced garlic, green chillies, onion cubes, and bell peppers on high heat for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, and 2 tbsp water. Toss fried paneer into the bubbling sauce for 1 minute.

name: Garlic Butter Sautéed Mushrooms
description: Fresh sliced button mushrooms pan-roasted in foaming garlic herb butter until caramelized, juicy, and golden.

instructions.instruction: Wipe mushrooms clean with a damp towel and cut into thick slices.
Melt generous butter with 1 tsp oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat.
Add mushrooms in a single layer without crowding; cook undisturbed for 4 minutes until deeply browned.
Flip, add minced garlic, black pepper, and salt. Sauté for 2 minutes and finish with fresh coriander.

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
description: Velvety comforting soup prepared with deeply browned mushrooms, sweet caramelized onions, garlic, and cream.

instructions.instruction: Slice mushrooms and dice onions and garlic.
Melt butter in a pot; sauté onions and garlic for 3 minutes, then add mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes until browned.
Pour in milk or water, black pepper, and salt. Simmer gently for 6 minutes.
Blend half of the soup for a thick creamy texture, return to pot, and serve hot with crusty bread.

name: Crispy Jeera Aloo (Cumin Spiced Potatoes)
description: Boiled potatoes cut into cubes and pan-roasted with abundant roasted cumin seeds, green chillies, and amchur.

instructions.instruction: Boil potatoes until just tender; peel and cut into 1-inch uniform cubes.
Heat oil or ghee in a pan. Add 2 tsp cumin seeds and let them sizzle until fragrant and deeply browned.
Add slit green chillies, turmeric, red chilli powder, salt, and the potato cubes.
Toss on medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes until potatoes develop a golden crispy exterior. Sprinkle fresh coriander.

name: Homestyle Aloo Gobi Matar (Potato, Cauliflower & Peas)
description: Classic North Indian everyday dry curry cooked with tender florets of cauliflower, diced potatoes, and sweet green peas.

instructions.instruction: Chop cauliflower into small florets, peel and cube potatoes, and rinse green peas.
Heat oil in a kadai; splutter cumin seeds, sliced ginger, and green chillies.
Add potatoes and cauliflower; sauté on medium heat with turmeric and salt for 5 minutes.
Add green peas, chopped tomatoes, and garam masala. Cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.

name: Crispy Garlic Potato Wedges
description: Oven-baked or pan-crisped potato wedges tossed in olive oil, crushed garlic, rosemary, paprika, and sea salt.

instructions.instruction: Scrub potatoes clean, cut lengthwise into wedges, and parboil in salted water for 5 minutes; drain thoroughly.
Toss wedges in olive oil, minced garlic, paprika, black pepper, and salt until evenly coated.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes or pan-fry in a shallow skillet on medium heat for 15 minutes, flipping once.
Serve steaming hot with ketchup, garlic mayo, or mint dip.

name: Homestyle Bhindi Masala (Crispy Spiced Okra)
description: Tender fresh okra sliced and pan-fried until non-sticky, tossed with onions, mango powder (amchur), and dry spices.

instructions.instruction: Wash bhindi and dry completely with a clean cloth before chopping into 1-inch pieces to prevent stickiness.
Heat oil in a wide pan; fry bhindi on medium flame for 8 minutes until crisp and no longer slimy; remove.
In same pan, sauté sliced onions and green chillies until golden brown.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt, and the fried bhindi. Toss on medium heat for 4 minutes.

name: Warm Cinnamon Apple & Honey Oatmeal Bowl
description: Rolled oats simmered in creamy milk, topped with tender pan-cooked diced apples, cinnamon spice, and pure golden honey.

instructions.instruction: Dice fresh apple into bite-sized cubes.
In a small pan, cook apple cubes with a dash of water, cinnamon, and 1 tsp honey for 3 minutes until tender.
In another pot, bring oats and milk (or water) to a gentle simmer for 4 minutes until thick and creamy.
Pour warm oatmeal into a bowl, top with cinnamon-cooked apples, and drizzle generous raw honey.

name: Baked Apple Cinnamon Oat Crisp
description: Sweet tender baked apples layered under a golden crispy crumble of rolled oats, honey, butter, and cinnamon.

instructions.instruction: Thinly slice apples and toss in a baking dish with 1 tbsp honey and cinnamon.
In a bowl, mix rolled oats with softened butter and 1 tbsp honey into coarse crumbles.
Spread the oat crumble evenly over the apples.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 15 minutes or cook on stovetop in a covered buttered skillet until apples soften and crumble is golden.

name: Apple Honey Overnight Oats Smoothie
description: Velvety chilled smoothie made by blending soaked oats with crisp sweet apples, chilled milk, and honey.

instructions.instruction: Core and chop sweet apple into chunks.
Add rolled oats, apple chunks, chilled milk, and honey into a blender.
Blend on high speed for 90 seconds until completely silky and smooth.
Pour into glasses and sprinkle a pinch of ground cinnamon on top.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick and creamy blend of ripe bananas, creamy peanut butter, milk, and honey, topped with fruit and nuts.

instructions.instruction: Peel ripe bananas and break into pieces into a high-speed blender.
Add creamy peanut butter, chilled milk, and 1 tbsp honey.
Blend on high speed for 60-90 seconds until completely thick, creamy, and velvety.
Pour into chilled glasses or a bowl; garnish with extra banana slices and a sprinkle of nuts.

name: Classic Golden Fluffy Pancakes
description: Melt-in-your-mouth fluffy homemade pancakes prepared with flour, milk, egg, butter, and served with honey or syrup.

instructions.instruction: Whisk flour, 1 tsp baking powder, a pinch of salt, and 1 tbsp sugar in a bowl.
In separate bowl, whisk milk, egg, and melted butter. Fold into dry ingredients until just combined.
Heat a non-stick griddle over medium heat and lightly butter. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on surface (about 2.5 minutes), flip, and cook 2 minutes more until golden. Serve with honey or butter.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Garlic & Chilli
description: Classic traditional Roman pasta tossed in extra virgin olive oil, sizzling golden garlic slivers, and fiery red chilli flakes.

instructions.instruction: Boil spaghetti in generously salted water until al dente (about 9-10 minutes); reserve 1/2 cup pasta cooking water.
In a wide skillet, heat 3 tbsp olive oil over low-medium heat. Add thinly sliced garlic and sauté gently until pale golden.
Add red chilli flakes or sliced green chillies and cook for 30 seconds.
Transfer drained spaghetti to the skillet with a splash of reserved pasta water. Toss vigorously for 2 minutes until glossy; top with parsley.

name: Penne all'Arrabbiata (Spicy Tomato Garlic Pasta)
description: Tube penne pasta coated in a fiery, rich Italian sauce made from ripe tomatoes, crushed garlic, and red chillies.

instructions.instruction: Boil penne pasta in rolling salted water for 10 minutes until al dente; drain and save 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a skillet; sauté lots of minced garlic and red chillies on medium flame until fragrant.
Add crushed ripe tomatoes or puree, salt, and black pepper. Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes until thick and rich.
Fold in boiled penne with a splash of pasta water. Toss vigorously for 2 minutes to emulsify sauce. Top with cheese.

name: Street Style Vegetable Hakka Noodles
description: Springy noodles flash-fried in a fiery wok with shredded cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, soy sauce, and chilli garlic.

instructions.instruction: Boil noodles until 90% cooked (about 4 minutes); rinse under cold water, toss with 1 tsp oil to prevent sticking.
Heat oil in a large wok over highest heat until smoking.
Toss in sliced onions, minced garlic, carrots, and bell peppers. Stir fry continuously for 2.5 minutes so veggies stay crunchy.
Add boiled noodles, 2 tbsp soy sauce, vinegar or lemon, salt, and black pepper. Toss vigorously on high flame for 2 minutes.

name: Creamy Stovetop Macaroni and Cheese
description: Elbow macaroni enveloped in a luscious, velvety cheddar cheese sauce made from butter, milk, and melted cheese.

instructions.instruction: Boil macaroni in salted water for 8 minutes until tender; drain.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a saucepan over medium heat; whisk in 1 tbsp flour or pour milk directly.
Simmer milk until hot; remove from flame and stir in abundant grated cheese until completely smooth and melted.
Fold warm macaroni into the cheese sauce; season with black pepper and salt to taste. Serve bubbling warm.

name: Garlic Butter Cheese Toast
description: Crisp bakery-style golden toast spread with rich garlic-herb butter and blankets of bubbling broiled cheese.

instructions.instruction: Mix softened butter with minced garlic, black pepper, and chopped coriander or parsley.
Generously spread garlic butter on one side of bread slices.
Top with grated cheese and chilli flakes or chopped green chillies.
Toast in a covered pan over low heat for 5 minutes until bottom is crispy and cheese is completely melted.

name: Mumbai Vegetable Grilled Sandwich
description: Triple decker street sandwich layered with sliced boiled potatoes, onions, tomatoes, cucumbers, and spicy green chutney.

instructions.instruction: Thinly slice boiled potatoes, ripe tomatoes, onions, and cucumber.
Butter bread slices generously and spread spicy green coriander chutney.
Layer vegetables neatly, sprinkle chaat masala and salt; cap with another slice and press together.
Grill or toast on tawa with butter until crispy golden brown on both sides. Slice into 4 squares.

name: Restaurant Style Dal Tadka
description: Yellow lentils cooked till creamy, tempered with a sizzling aromatic tadka of ghee, cumin seeds, garlic, and red chillies.

instructions.instruction: Cook toor dal or yellow lentils with turmeric, chopped tomato, and water in a pressure cooker for 3 whistles.
Mash the cooked dal lightly with a whisk; add salt and simmer for 3 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp ghee or butter in a small tadka pan. Add cumin seeds, lots of sliced garlic, dry red chillies, and curry leaves.
Pour the sizzling golden garlic tadka directly over the bubbling dal. Cover immediately to lock in the aroma!

name: Punjabi Chana Masala (Spiced Chickpea Curry)
description: Tender white chickpeas simmered in a robust, tangy, and deeply spiced onion-tomato-garlic gravy.

instructions.instruction: Boil soaked chickpeas until tender, or rinse canned chickpeas.
Heat oil in a pot; sauté finely chopped onions until deep reddish-brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Cook till oil releases.
Add cooked chickpeas with 1 cup cooking water. Mash a spoonful of chickpeas to thicken gravy; simmer for 10 minutes.

name: Tomato Rasam (Spicy Tangy South Indian Soup)
description: Soothing, aromatic South Indian herbal broth made with juicy tomatoes, tamarind, black pepper, cumin, and garlic.

instructions.instruction: Crush garlic, black pepper, and cumin seeds coarsely in a mortar and pestle.
In a pot, boil chopped tomatoes with tamarind water, turmeric, and salt for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the crushed pepper-garlic spice mixture and 1.5 cups water; bring to a single gentle frothy boil.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in 1 tsp ghee; garnish with fresh coriander.

name: Pan-Seared Lemon Garlic Butter Fish Fillet
description: Tender flaky white fish fillets seared with a golden crust in sizzling garlic herb butter and fresh lemon juice.

instructions.instruction: Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels; season both sides with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until sizzling.
Sear fillets for 3-4 minutes on first side without moving until golden crust forms; gently flip.
Add minced garlic, remaining butter, and lemon juice; spoon bubbling garlic butter over fish for 2 minutes until cooked.

name: Crispy Masala Tawa Fish Fry
description: Fish fillets marinated in a spicy paste of Kashmiri red chilli, ginger-garlic, turmeric, and lemon, pan-fried to crisp perfection.

instructions.instruction: Make a thick marinade paste using red chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, and salt.
Coat fish fillets thoroughly on both sides with the marinade; rest for 15 minutes.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wide tawa or skillet on medium flame.
Shallow fry fish for 4-5 minutes per side until deeply crisp and cooked through. Serve hot with onion rings.

name: Roasted Fresh Tomato Basil Soup
description: Rich comforting soup made with roasted ripe tomatoes, caramelized onions, garlic, and fresh basil, blended velvety smooth.

instructions.instruction: Cut tomatoes and onions in half. Place on baking sheet with garlic cloves, toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C for 20 minutes until blistered and caramelized (or roast directly in a heavy soup pot).
Transfer roasted vegetables to a blender, add fresh basil/coriander and 1 cup warm water or milk; blend until velvety.
Pour into bowls, swirl with butter or cream, and serve warm with grilled cheese or toast.

name: Fresh Cucumber, Tomato & Onion Salad
description: Crisp refreshing everyday salad with sliced cucumbers, juicy tomatoes, sweet onions, lemon juice, and black pepper.

instructions.instruction: Peel and slice cucumbers into thin rounds.
Chop ripe tomatoes and onions into bite-sized wedges.
Combine vegetables in a salad bowl with fresh coriander leaves.
Dress with fresh lemon juice, black pepper, and a pinch of salt just before serving.

name: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
description: Layered basmati rice and marinated chicken cooked on dum with fried onions, saffron, mint, and whole spices.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken with yogurt/lemon, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli, and garam masala for 20 mins.
Parboil basmati rice until 70% cooked with whole spices and salt.
Layer marinated chicken at bottom of pot, top with parboiled rice, fried onions, and coriander.
Seal pot with lid and cook on dum on low flame for 25 minutes.

name: Egg Dum Biryani
description: Fragrant spiced basmati rice layered with golden-fried whole boiled eggs, caramelized onions, and fresh herbs.

instructions.instruction: Boil eggs, peel, slit and shallow fry with turmeric and red chilli powder until golden crust forms.
Prepare spiced onion-tomato biryani gravy with ginger, garlic, and whole spices.
Parboil basmati rice until 70% done; drain.
Layer rice and fried eggs with masala, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 12 minutes.

name: Aromatic Vegetable Pulao
description: Fluffy basmati rice gently cooked with sweet green peas, diced carrots, potatoes, and whole aromatic spices.

instructions.instruction: Rinse basmati rice and soak in water for 15 minutes.
Heat oil or butter in a pot; crackle cumin seeds, bay leaf, cloves, and sliced onions.
Add diced potatoes, carrots, green peas, and ginger-garlic paste; sauté for 3 minutes.
Add drained rice, 2 cups water, and salt. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for 12 minutes until fluffy.

name: South Indian Tangy Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
description: Golden turmeric-infused cooked rice tempered with crunchy peanuts, mustard seeds, curry leaves, and fresh tart lemon.

instructions.instruction: Spread cooled cooked rice on a wide plate.
Heat oil in a pan; splutter mustard seeds, peanuts, green chillies, curry leaves, and turmeric.
Turn off heat and stir in fresh lemon juice and salt.
Pour the hot seasoning over the rice and gently fold until evenly yellow and aromatic.

name: Spicy South Indian Tomato Rice (Thakkali Sadam)
description: Aromatic cooked rice tossed in a rich, tangy spiced onion-tomato masala with curry leaves and mustard seeds.

instructions.instruction: Heat oil in a pan; crackle mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves, and sliced onions.
Add chopped juicy tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes become mushy and oil separates.
Add cooked rice to the pan and gently mix until well incorporated with the tomato masala.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve warm with papad or raita.

name: Soothing South Indian Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)
description: Cooling creamy yogurt rice tempered with mustard seeds, green chillies, curry leaves, and ginger.

instructions.instruction: Mash warm cooked rice slightly with a fork.
Mix in yogurt/curd, milk, and salt until smooth and creamy.
Heat 1 tsp oil; temper mustard seeds, finely chopped ginger, green chillies, and curry leaves.
Pour the tempering over curd rice and mix gently. Serve chilled or room temperature.

name: Jeera Rice (Fragrant Cumin Basmati)
description: Long-grain basmati rice scented with whole cumin seeds, butter or ghee, and fresh green coriander.

instructions.instruction: Heat butter or oil in a pot; add 2 tsp cumin seeds and let them sizzle until deeply aromatic.
Add soaked basmati rice and gently toast for 1 minute in the spiced butter.
Add water and salt; bring to a boil, cover tightly, and simmer on low for 10 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and garnish with chopped fresh coriander.

name: Garlic Butter Herb Rice
description: Fluffy fragrant rice tossed with sizzling golden garlic slivers, butter, and freshly cracked black pepper.

instructions.instruction: Melt generous butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant and lightly golden.
Add cooked rice, salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
Toss on medium-high heat for 3 minutes until rice is glossy and infused with garlic butter.

name: Kanda Poha (Savory Flaked Rice with Onions & Peanuts)
description: Light and fluffy flattened rice tossed with caramelized onions, crunchy peanuts, mustard seeds, turmeric, and lemon.

instructions.instruction: Rinse poha in a colander until soft; drain completely and toss with a pinch of turmeric and salt.
Heat oil in a pan; fry peanuts until crunchy, then add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chillies.
Add finely chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Fold in softened poha, cover and steam on low for 2 minutes. Squeeze fresh lemon juice on top.

name: High-Protein Besan Chilla (Savory Gram Flour Crepe)
description: Crispy savory golden pancakes made from spiced gram flour batter loaded with finely chopped onions, chillies, and herbs.

instructions.instruction: Whisk gram flour (besan) with water to form a smooth pourable batter.
Add chopped onions, green chillies, coriander, turmeric, and salt.
Pour ladleful of batter onto a hot greased tawa and spread in concentric circles.
Drizzle a few drops of oil, cook for 2 minutes per side until golden and crisp.

name: Healthy Savory Oats Veggie Chilla
description: Nutritious fiber-packed savory crepes made from blended oats batter, finely chopped veggies, and cumin.

instructions.instruction: Grind oats into a coarse flour. Mix with water, salt, and cumin into a smooth batter.
Stir in finely chopped onions, tomatoes, and green chillies.
Spread batter on a hot non-stick pan into a thin disc.
Cook with minimal oil for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden and crisp. Serve with chutney.

name: Mumbai Street Egg Kathi Roll
description: Crisp flaky flatbread layered with spiced beaten egg, rolled up with sliced onions, chaat masala, and spicy green chutney.

instructions.instruction: Cook flatbread/paratha on a hot tawa with a dab of butter until golden.
Pour beaten egg onto the pan and immediately press the paratha on top so it adheres.
Flip once the egg is cooked and crisp.
Lay out flat; fill center with sliced raw onions, green chillies, lemon juice, roll tightly, and wrap in paper.

name: Paneer Tikka Kathi Roll
description: Charred marinated paneer cubes rolled inside warm buttery flatbread with sliced crunchy onions and mint sauce.

instructions.instruction: Pan-sear paneer cubes with turmeric, red chilli, and ginger-garlic paste until lightly charred.
Warm flatbread on a tawa with butter.
Place spiced paneer in center with sliced onions and coriander.
Roll tightly into a cylindrical wrap and serve hot.

name: Chicken Kathi Roll (Kolkata Style)
description: Buttery flaky flatbread layered with spiced sautéed chicken strips, crisp onion rings, and tangy lemon juice.

instructions.instruction: Stir fry chicken strips with garlic, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt until cooked through and slightly browned.
Toast flatbread on a tawa with butter until crisp.
Layer cooked chicken along the center with thinly sliced onions and a squeeze of fresh lemon.
Roll tightly and enjoy immediately.

name: Tea-Time Crispy Onion Pakoda (Kanda Bhaji)
description: Golden, super crunchy street fritters prepared by tossing sliced onions in carom-spiced gram flour and frying crisp.

instructions.instruction: Thinly slice onions; toss with salt, green chillies, and coriander, letting onions release natural moisture.
Add gram flour (besan), red chilli powder, and a pinch of turmeric; mix without adding water.
Drop small loose clumps of onion batter into hot oil.
Fry on medium heat for 4-5 minutes until deeply golden and shatteringly crisp.

name: Crispy Masala Aloo Tikki
description: Spiced mashed potato patties pan-fried golden and crisp on a tawa, seasoned with green chillies, cumin, and coriander.

instructions.instruction: Boil potatoes, peel and mash smoothly while still warm.
Mix in chopped green chillies, coriander, cumin powder, and salt.
Shape into flat round patties (tikkis).
Shallow fry on a flat tawa with oil or butter for 4 minutes per side until crust is deeply browned and crisp.

name: Restaurant Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
description: Tender roasted chicken pieces bathed in an opulent, velvety smooth tomato gravy with rich butter and aromatic fenugreek.

instructions.instruction: Sear marinated chicken cubes in a skillet for 6 minutes until charred; remove.
In same pan, melt generous butter; add pureed tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and simmer until thick.
Stir in milk or cream, salt, and a pinch of sugar.
Add charred chicken pieces, simmer for 5 minutes, and finish with a knob of butter.

name: Spicy Kadai Chicken with Bell Peppers
description: Juicy chicken pieces wok-tossed with freshly ground kadai spices, chunky bell peppers, and onion petals in a thick gravy.

instructions.instruction: Heat oil in a kadai; sauté chicken pieces on high heat with ginger-garlic paste for 6 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli, and coriander powder; cook until tomatoes break down.
Toss in chunky bell peppers and onion petals; stir fry on high flame for 4 minutes so peppers remain crunchy.
Simmer for 4 minutes, garnish with fresh coriander, and serve hot.

name: Andhra Pepper Chicken Fry
description: Fiery Andhra-style semi-dry chicken roast loaded with freshly ground black pepper, garlic, and sizzling curry leaves.

instructions.instruction: Heat oil in a pan; add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and lots of sliced onions and garlic.
Add chicken pieces, turmeric, and salt; sear on high flame for 6 minutes.
Add 2 tablespoons of coarsely crushed black pepper and green chillies.
Roast uncovered on medium-high heat for 8 minutes until chicken is dark, tender, and coated in spicy pepper crust.

name: Telangana Kodi Vepudu (Rustic Chicken Fry)
description: Authentic Telangana dry-spiced country chicken fry slow-roasted with caramelized onions, curry leaves, and pounded spices.

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken with turmeric, red chilli, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a wide heavy kadai; add lots of curry leaves, sliced onions, and green chillies.
Add marinated chicken; cook on medium-high flame until all moisture evaporates.
Continue roasting the chicken on medium flame until oil separates and chicken turns deep golden brown.

name: Pan-Grilled Chicken Tikka Skewers
description: Boneless chicken cubes marinated in garlic, lemon, turmeric, and chilli, pan-grilled with charred smoky edges.

instructions.instruction: Cut chicken into uniform bite-sized cubes; toss with lemon juice, minced garlic, chilli, and salt.
Rest marinade for 15 minutes to tenderize meat.
Heat a grill pan or cast iron skillet with 1 tbsp butter/oil.
Cook chicken skewers for 5-6 minutes per side on high heat until charred spots appear and meat is fully cooked.

name: Chicken Sweet Corn Comfort Soup
description: Silky, comforting warm soup made with shredded chicken breast, creamed corn, egg ribbons, and cracked black pepper.

instructions.instruction: In a soup pot, bring 3 cups water to a simmer with shredded chicken, ginger, and garlic.
Add corn, salt, and black pepper; simmer for 5 minutes.
Slowly drizzle beaten egg while stirring soup in a circle to create delicate egg ribbons.
Turn off heat, stir in a drop of soy sauce or butter, and serve steaming hot.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad Bowl
description: Crisp salad greens, grilled chicken strips, garlic croutons, and cheese drizzled with creamy black pepper dressing.

instructions.instruction: Pan-sear chicken breast seasoned with salt and pepper in 1 tsp olive oil for 6 minutes per side; slice.
Toast diced bread cubes in pan with garlic butter until crunchy croutons form.
Toss cucumber or greens in a large bowl with a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.
Top with sliced chicken, crunchy croutons, and shaved cheese.

name: Matar Paneer (Cottage Cheese & Green Peas Curry)
description: Tender paneer cubes and sweet green peas simmered in a mildly spiced onion, tomato, and ginger garlic curry.

instructions.instruction: Lightly pan-fry paneer cubes in 1 tsp oil until golden; set aside.
Sauté chopped onions, ginger, and garlic in a pan until lightly browned.
Add tomato puree, turmeric, red chilli, and garam masala; cook until oil surfaces.
Add green peas, 1 cup water, and paneer cubes; simmer for 6 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

name: Smoky Punjabi Baingan Bharta
description: Whole eggplant roasted directly over open flames, mashed and sautéed with onions, juicy tomatoes, and green chillies.

instructions.instruction: Make small slits in eggplant, insert garlic cloves, and roast directly on stovetop flame for 10 minutes until charred and soft.
Peel off charred skin and mash the soft flesh with a fork.
Heat oil in a kadai; sauté chopped onions, green chillies, and tomatoes until soft.
Fold in mashed eggplant and salt; cook on medium flame for 5 minutes until well blended. Garnish with coriander.

name: Mushroom Pepper Masala
description: Sliced button mushrooms roasted on high heat with caramelized onions, curry leaves, garlic, and fresh black pepper.

instructions.instruction: Slice mushrooms and finely slice onions and garlic.
Heat oil in a pan; add curry leaves, green chillies, and sliced onions; sauté until golden brown.
Add mushrooms, turmeric, and salt; cook on high heat for 5 minutes until water evaporates and mushrooms brown.
Sprinkle abundant crushed black pepper and toss for 2 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

name: Aloo Matar Rasedar (Potato & Peas in Spiced Gravy)
description: Comforting everyday homestyle curry of boiled potato chunks and tender green peas in a light tomato-cumin gravy.

instructions.instruction: Heat oil in a pot; crackle cumin seeds, chopped green chillies, and ginger.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt; cook until tomatoes are soft.
Add boiled potato cubes, green peas, and 1.5 cups water.
Simmer on medium heat for 8 minutes, lightly crushing a few potato pieces to thicken gravy. Garnish with coriander.

name: Garlic Sautéed Spinach (Lehsuni Palak)
description: Fresh tender spinach leaves flash-sautéed in golden browned garlic slivers, butter, and a hint of cumin.

instructions.instruction: Wash spinach leaves thoroughly and roughly chop.
Melt butter or heat oil in a wide pan; add cumin seeds and lots of sliced garlic until golden and fragrant.
Add chopped spinach and green chillies; sauté on high heat for 3 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and serve immediately as a nutritious side.

name: Telangana Pachi Pulusu (Raw Tangy Tamarind Rasam)
description: Traditional uncooked summer stew from Telangana made with extract of tamarind, raw onions, roasted green chillies, and cumin.

instructions.instruction: Soak tamarind in warm water and extract 2 cups of light tamarind juice.
Roast green chillies on an open flame until charred; crush with salt, cumin, and garlic.
Add finely chopped raw onions, crushed chillies, and coriander into the tamarind extract.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in 1 tsp oil, pour over the pulusu and serve with hot rice.

name: Telangana Sarva Pindi (Crispy Rice Flour Pancake)
description: Iconic rustic pancake from northern Telangana studded with roasted peanuts, sesame seeds, chopped onions, and curry leaves.

instructions.instruction: In a bowl, mix rice flour, roasted peanuts, finely chopped onions, green chillies, curry leaves, and salt.
Add water gradually to knead into a soft, pliable dough.
Grease a flat kadai or tawa with oil; press dough into a flat pancake and make several small holes across the surface.
Drizzle oil into each hole, cover and cook on medium-low flame for 12-15 minutes until bottom is golden and crunchy.

name: Quick Tomato Cucumber Bruschetta on Toast
description: Crispy toasted bread slices rubbed with raw garlic and topped with diced ripe tomatoes, black pepper, and olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Dice ripe tomatoes and cucumber into tiny cubes; toss with salt, black pepper, and olive oil.
Toast bread slices until golden brown and crispy.
Lightly rub a cut clove of garlic over the warm toasted bread surface.
Spoon the fresh tomato mixture on top, garnish with coriander/basil, and serve immediately.

name: Sweet Honey Banana Caramelized Toast
description: Thick bread toasted in butter and topped with sliced ripe bananas caramelized with honey and a pinch of cinnamon.

instructions.instruction: Slice ripe banana into rounds.
Melt butter in a pan; add banana slices and drizzle 1 tbsp honey.
Cook for 2 minutes until bananas are tender and glazed with caramel.
Toast bread until golden, pile caramelized bananas on top, and enjoy warm.

name: Classic Banana Honey Milkshake
description: Thick, frosty milkshake blended with sweet ripe bananas, chilled whole milk, and pure natural honey.

instructions.instruction: Peel ripe bananas and break into pieces.
Add bananas, chilled milk, and honey into a blender.
Blend on high speed for 60 seconds until frothy and smooth.
Pour into tall glasses and serve immediately.

name: Fresh Honey Fruit Chaat Bowl
description: Refreshing colorful medley of diced apples, bananas, and cucumber tossed with fresh lemon juice, honey, and chaat masala.

instructions.instruction: Core and dice crisp apple into bite-sized cubes.
Slice bananas and peel and dice cucumber.
Combine fruits in a bowl and drizzle fresh lemon juice and honey.
Sprinkle a pinch of black pepper or chaat masala, toss gently, and enjoy chilled.

name: Green Detox Apple Spinach Smoothie
description: Revitalizing vibrant green smoothie made with sweet apples, tender baby spinach, chilled water, lemon, and honey.

instructions.instruction: Chop sweet apple and wash fresh spinach thoroughly.
Place apple, spinach, juice of half lemon, 1 tbsp honey, and 1 cup chilled water into a blender.
Blend on high speed for 90 seconds until silky smooth.
Pour into glasses and drink immediately for maximum nutrient absorption.

name: Sweet Honey Banana Oat Porridge
description: Warm, comforting porridge cooked with rolled oats and milk, swirled with mashed sweet banana and golden honey.

instructions.instruction: Mash half a banana with a fork; slice the remaining half for topping.
In a saucepan, combine oats, milk, and mashed banana; bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 4 minutes while stirring until thick and creamy.
Transfer to a bowl, top with sliced banana, and drizzle honey generously.

name: Quick Cheesy Garlic Herb Breadsticks
description: Crusty bread strips brushed with melted garlic butter, sprinkled with cheese and black pepper, toasted to golden crunch.

instructions.instruction: Slice bread into 1-inch strips.
Melt butter with minced garlic and black pepper.
Brush bread strips on all sides with garlic butter, top with grated cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 6 minutes or toast on a flat skillet until all sides are crunchy and cheese melts.

name: Warm Honey Lemon Ginger Immunity Tea
description: Soothing hot elixir made by brewing fresh crushed ginger and lemon slices in water, sweetened with natural pure honey.

instructions.instruction: Crush fresh ginger root coarsely.
Bring 2 cups water to a boil with crushed ginger; simmer for 4 minutes to extract flavor.
Strain into mugs, squeeze fresh lemon juice, and stir in honey.
Sip warm for soothing digestive and throat comfort.

name: Wok-Tossed Cantonese Egg Fried Rice
description: Fragrant day-old rice wok-fried on high heat with fluffy scrambled eggs, spring onions, cooking oil, and savory soy sauce.

instructions.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a hot wok. Pour whisked eggs and soft-scramble for 1 minute; set aside.
Add another tbsp cooking oil, sauté minced garlic and chillies on high flame for 30 seconds.
Toss in cooked rice, break clumps, and stir-fry vigorously for 3 minutes on high heat.
Fold in scrambled eggs, soy sauce, and salt. Toss for 2 minutes until smoky and fragrant.

name: Sizzling Garlic Chicken & Scallion Wok Toss
description: Tender chicken strips flash-seared in golden cooking oil with garlic, ginger, and cracked black pepper.

instructions.instruction: Slice chicken breast into uniform thin strips. Season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wok until shimmering hot. Flash-sear chicken for 5 minutes until golden.
Toss in finely minced garlic and sliced ginger; stir-fry rapidly on high heat for 2 minutes.
Drizzle with a dash of soy sauce, toss for 1 minute to glaze, and serve steaming hot.

name: Street-Style Garlic Chilli Wok Noodles
description: Springy noodles wok-tossed in smoking cooking oil with garlic, crunchy bell peppers, and chili sauce.

instructions.instruction: Boil noodles until al dente; rinse with cold water and toss with 1 tsp cooking oil to prevent sticking.
