Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wide wok. Sauté sliced garlic, onions, and bell peppers on high flame for 2 minutes.
Add noodles, soy sauce, and chillies. Toss vigorously on high heat for 3 minutes until smoky.

name: Authentic Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
description: Minced chicken stir-fried on blazing heat with fragrant garlic, fresh chillies, cooking oil, and savory Thai seasonings.

instructions.instruction: Mince or finely dice chicken. Pound garlic and green chillies into a coarse paste.
Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Fry garlic-chilli paste for 1 minute until intensely aromatic.
Add minced chicken, break apart with spatula, and stir-fry for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in soy sauce and a pinch of sugar; toss for 2 minutes and serve over steamed jasmine rice.

name: Thai Style Coconut Vegetable Curry
description: Fresh vegetables gently simmered in creamy spiced coconut milk, garlic, ginger, and turmeric.

instructions.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a pan; sauté minced garlic, ginger, and chillies for 2 minutes.
Add sliced carrots and bell peppers; sauté for 3 minutes.
Pour in 1 cup fresh coconut milk and 1/2 cup water; simmer on low heat for 6 minutes.
Fold in spinach leaves, season with salt, and simmer 1 minute until wilted. Serve hot with rice.

name: Glazed Chicken Teriyaki Skillet
description: Pan-seared chicken fillets glazed in a savory-sweet reduction of soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and golden cooking oil.

instructions.instruction: Score chicken lightly; season with salt and minced ginger.
Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sear chicken skin-side down for 5 minutes until crispy and golden.
Flip chicken and cook for 3 minutes. Pour in soy sauce, honey, and minced garlic.
Simmer glaze for 2 minutes, basting chicken constantly until glossy and rich.

name: Tamagoyaki (Japanese Sweet Rolled Omelette)
description: Delicate, golden layered rolled egg omelette cooked in gentle cooking oil with a hint of honey and soy.

instructions.instruction: Whisk 3 eggs with 1/2 tsp soy sauce, 1/2 tsp honey, and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Lightly grease a non-stick skillet with cooking oil using a paper towel; heat on medium-low.
Pour a thin layer of egg, let set partially, then gently roll to one side. Grease pan again and repeat in layers.
Slice into thick diagonal rounds and serve warm.

name: Sizzling Skillet Chicken Fajitas
description: Juicy chicken strips, crisp bell peppers, and caramelized onions pan-seared in cooking oil with Mexican spices.

instructions.instruction: Slice chicken, bell peppers, and onions into long uniform strips.
Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a heavy cast-iron skillet on high flame until very hot.
Add chicken and sear undisturbed for 4 minutes until browned; stir and cook 2 minutes more.
Toss in onions, bell peppers, cumin, and garlic. Sauté on blazing heat for 3 minutes. Finish with fresh lemon juice.

name: Fiesta Mexican Rice Skillet
description: Long grain rice toasted golden in cooking oil and simmered with onions, garlic, fresh tomatoes, and cumin.

instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a skillet. Add dry rice and toast on medium flame for 4 minutes until golden-tan.
Add diced onions and garlic; sauté for 2 minutes until translucent.
Stir in pureed tomato, cumin, salt, and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil.
Cover tightly with lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes undisturbed until fluffy.

name: Spaghetti Aglio, Olio e Peperoncino
description: Classic Italian masterpiece of al dente pasta tossed in warm extra virgin olive oil, sliced golden garlic, and chili flakes.

instructions.instruction: Boil pasta in generously salted water until al dente (about 8 minutes). Reserve 1/2 cup pasta cooking water.
In a wide skillet, heat 3 tbsp olive oil on low heat. Add thinly sliced garlic and chillies; gently sizzle for 2 minutes until garlic is pale golden.
Transfer pasta directly to the skillet with a splash of pasta water. Toss vigorously for 2 minutes to emulsify a glossy sauce.
Season with cracked black pepper and serve immediately.

name: Rustic Tuscan Tomato & Garlic Bruschetta
description: Artisanal crusty bread toasted golden in olive oil, rubbed with garlic, and topped with marinated sweet tomatoes.

instructions.instruction: Dice tomatoes finely; toss in a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper. Let rest 5 minutes.
Brush bread slices with olive oil and toast on a hot griddle or skillet for 3 minutes until crisp and golden.
Rub cut garlic clove gently over the warm toasted bread surfaces.
Spoon the seasoned tomatoes over the bread and serve immediately.

name: Classic French Rolled Herb Omelette au Beurre
description: A silky, creamy French rolled omelette cooked in foamy golden butter with fresh aromatics and delicate curds.

instructions.instruction: Whisk eggs thoroughly with salt and pepper until no whites remain visible.
Melt butter with a drop of cooking oil in an 8-inch non-stick skillet over medium-low heat until gently foaming.
Pour in eggs. Shake the pan rapidly with one hand while stirring in circles with a fork to form velvety small curds.
When the egg is creamy on top and set on bottom, tilt the pan and roll the omelette onto a warm plate.

name: Traditional Skillet Shakshuka with Poached Eggs
description: Gently poached fresh eggs nestled in a spiced, simmering skillet of tomatoes, bell peppers, garlic, and cumin in olive oil.

instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide skillet. Sauté chopped onions, bell peppers, and garlic for 4 minutes until tender.
Add diced tomatoes, cumin, and salt. Simmer over medium-low heat for 6 minutes until a rich, fragrant sauce forms.
Make small wells in the tomato sauce using a spoon; gently crack an egg into each well.
Cover with a lid and cook on low for 5 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain soft. Serve with warm bread.

name: Classic Diner-Style Scrambled Eggs & Artisanal Toast
description: Soft, buttery diner scrambled eggs served with golden pan-toasted artisanal bread slices.

instructions.instruction: Whisk eggs with a splash of milk, pinch of salt, and cracked black pepper.
Melt 1 tbsp butter and 1 tsp cooking oil in a skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour eggs and gently push curds from edge to center with a silicone spatula for 3 minutes until soft and custardy.
Toast bread to deep golden crunch; plate scrambled eggs alongside warm toast.

name: Korean Sesame Garlic Egg Rice Skillet
description: Crispy bottom rice skillet topped with fried egg, toasted sesame oil, garlic, and fresh chillies.

instructions.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a skillet on medium-high heat. Fry egg until edges are delightfully lace-crisp and yolk is runny.
Drizzle 1 tbsp sesame oil into the bottom of the pan, add cooked rice, and press down lightly to crisp the bottom for 3 minutes.
Top crispy rice with fried egg, minced garlic, soy sauce, and sliced green chillies. Mix vigorously while hot!

name: Pan-Seared Golden Chicken & Basmati Rice & Curd Skillet
description: Tender chicken pieces pan-seared to juicy perfection in sizzling cooking oil with Basmati Rice, Curd, Onion, Mint.

instructions.title: Chicken Cutting & Pat Dry
instructions.instruction: Wash chicken and pat completely dry with paper towels. Cut into uniform 1.5-inch pieces.
instructions.tip: A dry surface ensures intense browning rather than boiling in moisture.

instructions.title: Seasoning & Marination
instructions.instruction: Toss chicken with salt, cracked black pepper, and your seasonings. Let sit for 3 minutes.
instructions.tip: Pre-salting dissolves surface protein to trap juicy moisture.

instructions.title: Skillet Preheating
instructions.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
instructions.tip: The skillet must be very hot so chicken sears immediately upon contact.

instructions.title: Pan-Sear First Side
instructions.instruction: Lay chicken pieces in the pan in a single layer. Sear undisturbed for 4 minutes until deeply golden.
instructions.tip: Do not move the pieces during the first 3 minutes to build a crust.

instructions.title: Flipping & Second Side Sear
instructions.instruction: Flip each piece with tongs. Sear the second side on medium flame for 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.tip: Chicken is done when internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F).

instructions.title: Basting with Pan Juices
instructions.instruction: Add aromatics and spoon the hot pan drippings over the chicken for 1 minute for a glossy glaze.
instructions.tip: Pan-basting distributes seasoning across the exterior crust.

instructions.title: Resting & Slicing
instructions.instruction: Transfer chicken onto a warm plate and rest for 2 minutes to let juices settle evenly.
instructions.tip: Resting prevents juices from running out when cut.

instructions.title: Plating & Service
instructions.instruction: Garnish with fresh herbs and a wedge of lemon. Serve sizzling hot!
instructions.tip: Serve immediately for the best crispy skin and juicy center.

name: Sizzling High-Heat Chicken & Basmati Rice & Curd Stir-Fry
description: Flash-seared chicken cubes cooked on high heat in cooking oil with savory aromatics for intense flavor.

instructions.title: Thin Slicing & Veggie Prep
instructions.instruction: Slice chicken into thin bite-sized strips. Thinly slice garlic, ginger, and vegetables.
instructions.tip: Thin uniform strips cook rapidly on high wok heat.

instructions.title: Wok Preheating on High Flame
instructions.instruction: Place wok on high heat until wisps of smoke appear. Swirl 2 tbsp cooking oil around the walls.
instructions.tip: High heat imparts restaurant-grade wok-hei.

instructions.title: Flash-Searing Chicken
instructions.instruction: Add chicken strips to the blazing wok. Stir-fry vigorously for 4 minutes until golden and seared.
instructions.tip: Keep moving chicken continuously to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: Aromatics Sauté
instructions.instruction: Toss in minced garlic and ginger. Sauté on high flame for 1 minute until fragrant.
instructions.tip: Add garlic after chicken so it does not burn on high heat.

instructions.title: Vegetable & Sauce Addition
instructions.instruction: Add chopped vegetables, soy sauce or seasonings. Stir-fry rapidly for 2 minutes to keep crunch.
instructions.tip: Brief cooking maintains vibrant vegetable colors and crispness.

instructions.title: High-Heat Glaze
instructions.instruction: Toss continuously on maximum flame for 1 minute so sauce reduces to a glossy coating.
instructions.tip: The glaze should cling tightly without pooling at the bottom.

instructions.title: Plating & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Transfer steaming hot onto a serving platter, garnish with scallions, and serve immediately!
instructions.tip: Stir fries are best enjoyed straight from the wok.

name: Chef's Biryani Masala Spiced Chicken & Basmati Rice & Curd Roast
description: Chicken roasted on a pan in aromatic cooking oil with Biryani Masala & Turmeric Powder & Red Chilli Powder.

instructions.title: Chicken Mise en Place & Prep
instructions.instruction: Rinse chicken, pat dry with paper towels, and cut into uniform 1.5-inch pieces. Measure out 2 tbsp cooking oil, Biryani Masala, Turmeric Powder, Red Chilli Powder, salt, and slice aromatics.
instructions.tip: Drying chicken surface ensures spices stick and roast evenly.

instructions.title: Kadai Preheating & Oil Tempering
instructions.instruction: Place a heavy kadai on medium heat. Pour in 2 tbsp cooking oil and swirl until shimmering gently.
instructions.tip: A heavy-bottomed kadai distributes heat evenly and prevents hot spots.

instructions.title: Aromatics Sauté
instructions.instruction: Add chopped onions, minced ginger-garlic, and green chillies into the hot oil. Sauté on medium heat for 3 minutes until golden-brown.
instructions.tip: Sautéing onions till golden gives the roast its rich sweet foundation.

instructions.title: Masala Blooming & Paste
instructions.instruction: Lower flame to low. Add Biryani Masala. Bloom in warm oil for 45 seconds, adding 2 tbsp water to create a rich bubbling paste.
instructions.tip: Adding a splash of water prevents dry masala powders from scorching.

instructions.title: High-Heat Chicken Sear
instructions.instruction: Increase flame to medium-high. Add chicken pieces into the bubbling masala. Sauté vigorously for 5 minutes, coating every piece thoroughly while searing the outer crust.
instructions.tip: Sear chicken on high heat to lock inside juices and infuse deep flavor.

instructions.title: Covered Simmer & Tenderizing
instructions.instruction: Reduce flame to low-medium. Cover tightly with a lid and simmer for 8 minutes in natural juices, stirring once halfway.
instructions.tip: Trapped steam tenderizes the chicken to the bone while keeping it succulent.

instructions.title: Uncovered Reduction & Roast
instructions.instruction: Remove lid. Sauté uncovered on medium heat for 3-4 minutes until gravy reduces into a thick, glossy, deep-roasted masala coating.
instructions.tip: Stir continuously so the masala roasts evenly around every chicken piece.

instructions.title: Final Seasoning, Resting & Garnish
instructions.instruction: Turn off heat. Adjust salt, garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves and a squeeze of fresh lemon. Rest 2 minutes before serving hot!
instructions.tip: Resting allows internal juices to redistribute for ultimate tenderness.
